# Introduction
Welcome to the reference for the Lichess API! Lichess is free/libre,
open-source chess server powered by volunteers and donations.
- Get help in the [Lichess Discord channel](https://discord.gg/lichess)
- API demo app with OAuth2 login and gameplay: [source](https://github.com/lichess-org/api-demo) / [demo](https://lichess-org.github.io/api-demo/)
- API UI app with OAuth2 login and endpoint forms: [source](https://github.com/lichess-org/api-ui) / [website](https://lichess.org/api/ui)
- [Contribute to this documentation on Github](https://github.com/lichess-org/api)
- Check out [Lichess widgets to embed in your website](https://lichess.org/developers)
- [Download all Lichess rated games](https://database.lichess.org/)
- [Download all Lichess puzzles with themes, ratings and votes](https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles)
- [Download all evaluated positions](https://database.lichess.org/#evals)

## Endpoint
All requests go to `https://lichess.org` (unless otherwise specified).

## Clients
- [Python general API](https://github.com/lichess-org/berserk)
- [MicroPython general API](https://github.com/mkomon/uberserk)
- [Python general API - async](https://pypi.org/project/async-lichess-sdk)
- [Python Lichess Bot](https://github.com/lichess-bot-devs/lichess-bot)
- [Python Board API for Certabo](https://github.com/haklein/certabo-lichess)
- [Java general API](https://github.com/tors42/chariot)
- [JavaScript & TypeScript general API](https://github.com/devjiwonchoi/equine)
- [Rust general API](https://github.com/obazin/litchee)
- [LichessNET - C# API Wrapper](https://github.com/Rabergsel/LichessNET)
- [.NET general API](https://github.com/Dblike/LichessSharp)

## Rate limiting
All requests are rate limited using various strategies,
to ensure the API remains responsive for everyone.
Only make one request at a time.
If you receive an HTTP response with a [429 status](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_HTTP_status_codes#429),
you have exceded one of the rate limits.
In most cases, waiting one minute before retrying will be sufficient, but some limits may require longer.
Reduce your request frequency before retrying.

## Streaming with ND-JSON
Some API endpoints stream their responses as [Newline Delimited JSON a.k.a. **nd-json**](https://github.com/ndjson/ndjson-spec), with one JSON object per line.

Here's a [JavaScript utility function](https://gist.github.com/ornicar/a097406810939cf7be1df8ea30e94f3e) to help reading NDJSON streamed responses.

## Authentication
### Which authentication method is right for me?
[Read about the Lichess API authentication methods and code examples](https://github.com/lichess-org/api-demo/blob/master/example/README.md)

### Personal Access Token
Personal API access tokens allow you to quickly interact with Lichess API without going through an OAuth flow.
- [Generate a personal access token](https://lichess.org/account/oauth/token)
- `curl https://lichess.org/api/account -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}"`
- [NodeJS example](https://github.com/lichess-org/api-demo/tree/master/example/oauth-personal-token)

### Token Security
- Keep your tokens secret. Do not share them in public repositories or public forums.
- Your tokens can be used to make your account perform arbitrary actions (within the limits of the tokens' scope). You remain responsible for all activities on your account.
- Do not hardcode tokens in your application's code. Use environment variables or a secure storage and ensure they are not shipped/exposed to users. Be especially careful that they are not included in frontend bundles or apps that are shipped to users.
- If you suspect a token has been compromised, revoke it immediately.

To see your active tokens or revoke them, see [your Personal API access tokens](https://lichess.org/account/oauth/token).

### Authorization Code Flow with PKCE
The authorization code flow with PKCE allows your users to **login with Lichess**.
Lichess supports unregistered and public clients (no client authentication, choose any unique client id).
The only accepted code challenge method is `S256`.
Access tokens are long-lived (expect one year), unless they are revoked.
Refresh tokens are not supported.

See the [documentation for the OAuth endpoints](#tag/OAuth) or
the [PKCE RFC](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7636#section-4) for a precise protocol description.

- [Demo app](https://lichess-org.github.io/api-demo/)
- [Minimal client-side example](https://github.com/lichess-org/api-demo/tree/master/example/oauth-app)
- [Flask/Python example](https://github.com/lakinwecker/lichess-oauth-flask)
- [Java example](https://github.com/tors42/lichess-oauth-pkce-app)
- [NodeJS Passport strategy to login with Lichess OAuth2](https://www.npmjs.com/package/passport-lichess)

#### Real life examples
- [PyChess](https://github.com/gbtami/pychess-variants) ([source code](https://github.com/gbtami/pychess-variants))
- [Lichess4545](https://www.lichess4545.com/) ([source code](https://github.com/cyanfish/heltour))
- [English Chess Federation](https://ecf.octoknight.com/)
- [mktour](https://mktour.org) ([source code](https://github.com/mkeverything/mktour))

### Token format
Access tokens and authorization codes match `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$`.
The length of tokens can be increased without notice. Make sure your application can handle at least 512 characters.
By convention tokens have a recognizable prefix, but do not rely on this.

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://lichess.org">https://lichess.org</a>

* <a href="https://lichess.dev">https://lichess.dev</a>

* <a href="http://localhost:8080">http://localhost:8080</a>

* <a href="http://l.org">http://l.org</a>

Email: <a href="mailto:contact@lichess.org">Lichess.org API</a> 
Web: <a href="https://lichess.org/api">Lichess.org API</a> 
License: <a href="https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.txt">AGPL-3.0-or-later</a>

- oAuth2 authentication. Read [the introduction for how to make authenticated requests](#description/authentication).

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|preference:read|Read your preferences|
|preference:write|Write your preferences|
|email:read|Read your email address|
|engine:read|Read your external engines|
|engine:write|Create, update, delete your external engines|
|challenge:read|Read incoming challenges|
|challenge:write|Create, accept, decline challenges|
|challenge:bulk|Create, delete, query bulk pairings|
|study:read|Read private studies and broadcasts|
|study:write|Create, update, delete studies and broadcasts|
|tournament:write|Create tournaments|
|racer:write|Create and join puzzle races|
|puzzle:read|Read puzzle activity|
|puzzle:write|Write puzzle activity|
|team:read|Read private team information|
|team:write|Join, leave teams|
|team:lead|Manage teams (kick members, send PMs)|
|follow:read|Read followed players|
|follow:write|Follow and unfollow other players|
|msg:write|Send private messages to other players|
|note:write|Write notes on other players|
|board:play|Play with the Board API|
|bot:play|Play with the Bot API. Only for [Bot accounts](#tag/bot/POST/api/bot/account/upgrade)|
|web:mod|Use moderator tools (within the bounds of your permissions)|

## Get cloud evaluation of a position.

<a id="opIdapiCloudEval"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://lichess.org/api/cloud-eval?fen=r1bqkbnr%2Fpppp1ppp%2F2n5%2F1B2p3%2F4P3%2F5N2%2FPPPP1PPP%2FRNBQK2R%20b%20KQkq%20-%203%203' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/cloud-eval`

Get the cached evaluation of a position, if available.
Opening positions have more chances of being available. There are about 320 million positions in the database.
Up to 5 variations may be available. Variants are supported.
Use this endpoint to fetch a few positions here and there.
If you want to download a lot of positions, [get the full list](https://database.lichess.org/#evals) from our exported database.


<h3 id="get-cloud-evaluation-of-a-position-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fen|query|string|true|X-FEN of the position|
|multiPv|query|integer|false|Number of variations|
|variant|query|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|Variant|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|variant|standard|
|variant|chess960|
|variant|crazyhouse|
|variant|antichess|
|variant|atomic|
|variant|horde|
|variant|kingOfTheHill|
|variant|racingKings|
|variant|threeCheck|
|variant|fromPosition|

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-board">Board</h1>

Play on Lichess with physical boards and third-party clients.
Works with normal Lichess accounts. Engine play or assistance is [forbidden](https://lichess.org/page/fair-play).

### Features
- [Stream incoming chess moves](#tag/board/GET/api/board/game/stream/{gameId})
- [Play chess moves](#tag/board/POST/api/board/game/{gameId}/move/{move})
- [Read](#tag/board/GET/api/board/game/stream/{gameId}) and [write](#tag/board/POST/api/board/game/{gameId}/chat) in the player and spectator chats
- [Receive](#tag/board/GET/api/stream/event), [create](#tag/challenges/POST/api/challenge/{username}) and [accept](#tag/challenges/POST/api/challenge/{challengeId}/accept) (or [decline](#tag/challenges/POST/api/challenge/{challengeId}/decline)) challenges
- [Abort](#tag/board/POST/api/board/game/{gameId}/abort) and [resign](#tag/board/POST/api/board/game/{gameId}/resign) games
- Compatible with normal Lichess accounts

### Restrictions
- Engine assistance, or any kind of outside help, is [forbidden](https://lichess.org/page/fair-play)
- Time controls: [Rapid, Classical and Correspondence](https://lichess.org/faq#time-controls) only.
  For direct challenges, games vs AI, and bulk pairing, Blitz is also possible.

### Links
- [Announcement](https://lichess.org/blog/XlRW5REAAB8AUJJ-/welcome-lichess-boards)
- [Implementation example](https://github.com/lichess-org/api-demo) and [live demo](https://lichess-org.github.io/api-demo/)
- [Certabo support](https://github.com/haklein/certabo-lichess)
- [Lichs (play from command-line)](https://github.com/Cqsi/lichs)
- [Lichess discord bot](https://top.gg/bot/707287095911120968)
- [cli-chess](https://github.com/trevorbayless/cli-chess/)
- [Blunderly 3D board](https://github.com/maurimo/blunderly)
- Yours? Please make [an issue or pull request](https://github.com/lichess-org/api).


## Stream incoming events

<a id="opIdapiStreamEvent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/stream/event \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/stream/event`

Stream the events reaching a lichess user in real time as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).

An empty line is sent every 7 seconds for keep alive purposes.

Each non-empty line is a JSON object containing a `type` field. Possible values are:
- `gameStart` Start of a game
- `gameFinish` Completion of a game
- `challenge` A player sends you a challenge or you challenge someone
- `challengeCanceled` A player cancels their challenge to you
- `challengeDeclined` The opponent declines your challenge

When the stream opens, all current challenges and games are sent.

Only one global event stream can be active at a time. When the stream opens, the previous one with the same access token is closed.


> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json

  "game": {
```

## Create a seek

<a id="opIdapiBoardSeek"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/board/seek \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'rated=true&variant=standard&ratingRange=string&time=15&increment=15&color=white'
```

`POST /api/board/seek`

Create a public seek, to start a game with a random player.

### Real-time seek

Specify the `time` and `increment` clock values.
The response is streamed but doesn't contain any information.

**Keep the connection open to keep the seek active**.

If the client closes the connection, the seek is canceled. This way, if the client terminates, the user won't be paired in a game they wouldn't play.
When the seek is accepted, or expires, the server closes the connection.

**Make sure to also have an [Event stream](#tag/board/GET/api/board/game/stream/{gameId}) open**, to be notified when a game starts.
We recommend opening the [Event stream](#tag/board/GET/api/board/game/stream/{gameId}) first, then the seek stream. This way,
you won't miss the game event if the seek is accepted immediately.

### Correspondence seek

Specify the `days` per turn value.
The response is not streamed, it immediately completes with the seek ID. The seek remains active on the server until it is joined by someone.


> Body parameter

```yaml
rated: true
variant: standard
ratingRange: string
time: 15
increment: 15
color: white
```

<h3 id="create-a-seek-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|Parameters of the seek|
|» rated|body|boolean|false|Whether the game is rated and impacts players ratings.|
|» variant|body|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|none|
|» ratingRange|body|string|false|The rating range of potential opponents. Better left empty.<br>Example: 1500-1800<br>|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» time|body|number|true|Clock initial time in minutes. Required for real-time seeks.|
|» increment|body|integer|true|Clock increment in seconds. Required for real-time seeks.|
|» color|body|[ChallengeColor](#schemachallengecolor)|false|The color to play. Better left empty to automatically get 50% white.|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» days|body|integer|true|Days per turn. Required for correspondence seeks.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» variant|standard|
|» variant|chess960|
|» variant|crazyhouse|
|» variant|antichess|
|» variant|atomic|
|» variant|horde|
|» variant|kingOfTheHill|
|» variant|racingKings|
|» variant|threeCheck|
|» variant|fromPosition|
|» color|white|
|» color|black|
|» color|random|
|» days|1|
|» days|2|
|» days|3|
|» days|5|
|» days|7|
|» days|10|
|» days|14|

```json
}
```

## Stream Board game state

<a id="opIdboardGameStream"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/board/game/stream/5IrD6Gzz \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/board/game/stream/{gameId}`

Stream the state of a game being played with the Board API, as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).

Use this endpoint to get updates about the game in real-time, with a single request.

Each line is a JSON object containing a `type` field. Possible values are:
  - `gameFull` Full game data. All values are immutable, except for the `state` field.
  - `gameState` Current state of the game. Immutable values not included. Sent when a move is played, a draw is offered, or when the game ends.
  - `chatLine` Chat message sent by a user in the `room` "player" or "spectator".
  - `opponentGone` Whether the opponent has left the game, and how long before you can claim a win or draw.

The first line is always of type `gameFull`.

The server closes the stream when the game ends, or if the game has already ended.


<h3 id="stream-board-game-state-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|gameId|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "qP8XaFtN",
  "variant": {
    "key": "standard",
    "name": "Standard",
    "short": "Std"
  },
  "speed": "blitz",
  "perf": {
    "name": "Blitz"
  },
  "rated": false,
  "createdAt": 1793058022546,
  "white": {
    "id": "kenneth",
    "name": "Kenneth",
    "title": null,
    "rating": 566
  },
  "black": {
    "id": "salma",
    "name": "Salma",
    "title": null,
    "rating": 662
  },
  "initialFen": "startpos",
  "clock": {
    "initial": 300000,
    "increment": 0
  },
  "type": "gameFull",
  "state": {
    "type": "gameState",
    "moves": "",
    "wtime": 300000,
    "btime": 300000,
    "winc": 0,
    "binc": 0,
    "status": "started"
  }
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="stream-board-game-state-responses">Responses</h3>

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The stream of the game.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|The game was not found.|[NotFound](#schemanotfound)|

|*oneOf*|[ChatLineEvent](#schemachatlineevent)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|[OpponentGoneEvent](#schemaopponentgoneevent)|false|none|none|

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-bot">Bot</h1>

Play on Lichess as a bot. Allows engine play.
Read the [blog post announcement of lichess bots](https://lichess.org/blog/WvDNticAAMu_mHKP/welcome-lichess-bots).

Only works with [Bot accounts](#tag/bot/POST/api/bot/account/upgrade).

### Features
- [Stream incoming chess moves](#tag/bot/GET/api/bot/game/stream/{gameId})
- [Play chess moves](#tag/bot/POST/api/bot/game/{gameId}/move/{move})
- [Read](#tag/bot/GET/api/bot/game/stream/{gameId}) and [write](#tag/bot/POST/api/bot/game/{gameId}/chat) in the player and spectator chats
- [Receive](#tag/bot/GET/api/stream/event), [create](#tag/challenges/POST/api/challenge/{username}) and [accept](#tag/challenges/POST/api/challenge/{challengeId}/accept) (or [decline](#tag/challenges/POST/api/challenge/{challengeId}/decline)) challenges
- [Abort](#tag/bot/POST/api/bot/game/{gameId}/abort) and [resign](#tag/bot/POST/api/bot/game/{gameId}/resign) games
- Engine assistance is [allowed](https://lichess.org/page/fair-play)
### Restrictions
- Bots can only play challenge games:  pools and tournaments are off-limits
- Bots cannot play UltraBullet (¼+0) because it requires making too many requests. But 0+1 and ½+0 are allowed.
- Bots must follow [Lichess TOS](https://lichess.org/terms-of-service) specifically Sandbagging, Constant Aborting, Boosting, etc
- Bot devs are advised to make their Bots play casual only when testing their Bots logic and to avoid breaking Lichess TOS.
### Integrations
- [Python3 lichess-bot](https://github.com/lichess-bot-devs/lichess-bot) (official)
- [Python3 lichess UCI bot](https://github.com/Torom/BotLi)
- [JavaScript bot-o-tron](https://github.com/tailuge/bot-o-tron)
- [Golang lichess-bot](https://github.com/dolegi/lichess-bot)
- [Electronic Chessboard](http://www.oliviermercier.com/res/projects/chessboard/)
- Yours? Please make [an issue or pull request](https://github.com/lichess-org/api).
### Links
- [Announcement](https://lichess.org/blog/WvDNticAAMu_mHKP/welcome-lichess-bots)
- Join the [Lichess Bots team](https://lichess.org/team/lichess-bots) with your bot account
- [Get help in the discord channel](https://discord.gg/quwueFd)
- Watch [Lichess Bot TV](https://lichess.org/tv/bot)

## Upgrade to Bot account

<a id="opIdbotAccountUpgrade"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/bot/account/upgrade \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/bot/account/upgrade`

Upgrade a lichess player account into a Bot account. Only Bot accounts can use the Bot API.
The account **cannot have played any game** before becoming a Bot account. The upgrade is **irreversible**. The account will only be able to play as a Bot.
To upgrade an account to Bot, use the [official lichess-bot client](https://github.com/lichess-bot-devs/lichess-bot), or follow these steps:
- Create an [API access token](https://lichess.org/account/oauth/token/create?scopes[]=bot:play) with "Play bot moves" permission.
- `curl -d '' https://lichess.org/api/bot/account/upgrade -H "Authorization: Bearer <yourTokenHere>"`
To know if an account has already been upgraded, use the [Get my profile API](#tag/account/GET/api/account):
the `title` field should be set to `BOT`.


> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ok": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="upgrade-to-bot-account-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The bot account was successfully upgraded.|[Ok](#schemaok)|

## Stream Bot game state

<a id="opIdbotGameStream"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/bot/game/stream/5IrD6Gzz \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/bot/game/stream/{gameId}`

Stream the state of a game being played with the Bot API, as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).
Use this endpoint to get updates about the game in real-time, with a single request.
Each line is a JSON object containing a `type` field. Possible values are:
- `gameFull` Full game data. All values are immutable, except for the `state` field.
- `gameState` Current state of the game. Immutable values not included.
- `chatLine` Chat message sent by a user (or the bot itself) in the `room` "player" or "spectator".
- `opponentGone` Whether the opponent has left the game, and how long before you can claim a win or draw.
The first line is always of type `gameFull`.


<h3 id="stream-bot-game-state-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|gameId|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "bGpfV8Iv",
  "variant": {
    "key": "standard",
    "name": "Standard",
    "short": "Std"
  },
  "speed": "blitz",
  "perf": {
    "name": "Blitz"
  },
  "rated": false,
  "createdAt": 1793058087963,
  "white": {
    "id": "akeem",
    "name": "Akeem",
    "title": null,
    "rating": 1587
  },
  "black": {
    "id": "bot0",
    "name": "Bot0",
    "title": "BOT",
    "rating": 1500,
    "provisional": true
  },
  "initialFen": "startpos",
  "clock": {
    "initial": 300000,
    "increment": 0
  },
  "type": "gameFull",
  "state": {
    "type": "gameState",
    "moves": "",
    "wtime": 300000,
    "btime": 300000,
    "winc": 0,
    "binc": 0,
    "status": "started"
  }
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-broadcasts">Broadcasts</h1>

Relay chess events on Lichess.
[Official broadcasts](https://lichess.org/broadcast) are maintained by Lichess,
but you can [create your own broadcasts](https://lichess.org/broadcast/new) to cover any live game or chess event.
You will need to publish PGN on a public URL so that Lichess can pull updates from it.
Alternatively, you can push PGN updates to Lichess using [this API endpoint](#tag/broadcasts/POST/api/broadcast/round/{broadcastRoundId}/push).

Broadcasts are organized in tournaments, which have several rounds, which have several games.
You must first create a tournament, then you can add rounds to them.
Tournaments can be linked together in a group.

All tournament endpoint requests must be authenticated with (at least) a `study:read` token.
Unauthenticated endpoints are [heavily rate-limited and might stop functioning](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/pull/21283).


## Get official broadcasts

<a id="opIdbroadcastsOfficial"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/broadcast
```

`GET /api/broadcast`

Returns active (a round is scheduled or ongoing) official broadcasts sorted by tier. 
After that, returns finished broadcasts sorted by most recent sync time.
Broadcasts are streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).

|html|query|boolean|false|Convert the "description" field from markdown to HTML|
|live|query|boolean|false|[Filter] only broadcasts where a round is ongoing, i.e. started and not finished|

<a id="opIdbroadcastsByUser"></a>

```bash

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/broadcast/by/{username}`

Get all incoming, ongoing, and finished official broadcasts.
The broadcasts are sorted by created date, most recent first.

If you are authenticated as the user whose broadcasts you are requesting, you will also see your private and unlisted broadcasts.


<h3 id="get-broadcasts-created-by-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|username|path|string|true|none|
|page|query|integer|false|none|
|html|query|boolean|false|Convert the "description" field from markdown to HTML|

## Create a broadcast tournament

<a id="opIdbroadcastTourCreate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/broadcast/new \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'name=string&info=%7B%22format%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tc%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22fideTC%22%3A%22standard%22%2C%22timeZone%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22location%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22players%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22website%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%22%2C%22standings%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%22%2C%22regulations%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%22%7D&markdown=string&showScores=false&showRatingDiffs=false&teamTable=false&visibility=public&players=string&teams=string&tier=3&tiebreaks=%5B%22AOB%22%5D&grouping=%7B%22info%22%3A%7B%22name%22%3A%22Chess%20Olympiad%20%7C%20Open%22%2C%22tours%22%3A%22wYigbpXq%5CnM5YHvpOX%5Cnq6ezoCXP%5Cn%22%7D%2C%22scoreGroups%22%3A%5B%22wYigbpXq%2CM5YHvpOX%22%5D%7D'
```

`POST /broadcast/new`

Create a new broadcast tournament to relay external games.
This endpoint accepts the same form data as the [web form](https://lichess.org/broadcast/new).


> Body parameter

```yaml
name: string
info:
  format: string
  tc: string
  fideTC: standard
  timeZone: string
  location: string
  players: string
  website: "http://example.com"
  standings: "http://example.com"
  regulations: "http://example.com"
markdown: string
showScores: false
showRatingDiffs: false
teamTable: false
visibility: public
players: string
teams: string
tier: 3
tiebreaks:
  - AOB
grouping:
  info:
    name: "Chess Olympiad | Open"
    tours: "wYigbpXq\nM5YHvpOX\nq6ezoCXP\n"
  scoreGroups:
    - "wYigbpXq,M5YHvpOX"
```

<h3 id="create-a-broadcast-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[BroadcastForm](#schemabroadcastform)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the broadcast tournament.<br><br>Example: `Sinquefield Cup`<br>|
|» info|body|[BroadcastTourInfo](#schemabroadcasttourinfo)|false|Additional display information about the tournament|
|» markdown|body|string|false|Optional long description of the broadcast. Markdown is supported.<br>|
|» showScores|body|boolean|false|Show players scores based on game results<br>|
|» showRatingDiffs|body|boolean|false|Show player's rating diffs<br>|
|» teamTable|body|boolean|false|Show a team leaderboard. Requires WhiteTeam and BlackTeam PGN tags.<br>|
|» visibility|body|string|false|Who can view the broadcast.<br>* `public`: Default. Anyone can view the broadcast<br>* `unlisted`: Only people with the link can view the broadcast<br>* `private`: Only the broadcast owner(s) can view the broadcast<br>|
|» players|body|string|false|Optional replace player names, ratings and titles.<br><br>One line per player, formatted as such:<br><br>```txt<br>player name / FIDE ID<br>```<br><br>Example:<br><br>```txt<br>Magnus Carlsen / 1503014<br>```<br><br>Player names ignore case and punctuation, and match all possible combinations of 2 words: "Jorge Rick Vito" will match "Jorge Rick", "jorge vito", "Rick, Vito", etc.<br><br>If the player is NM or WNM, you can:<br><br>```txt<br>player name / FIDE ID / title<br>```<br><br>Alternatively, you may set tags manually, like so:<br><br>```txt<br>player name / rating / title / new name<br>```<br><br>All values are optional. Example:<br>```txt<br>Magnus Carlsen / 2863 / GM<br>YouGotLittUp / 1890 / / Louis Litt<br>```<br>|
|» teams|body|string|false|Optional: assign players to teams<br><br>One line per player, formatted as such:<br>```txt<br>Team name; Fide Id or Player name<br>```<br><br>Example:<br>```txt<br>Team Cats ; 3408230<br>Team Dogs ; Scooby Doo<br>```<br><br>By default the PGN tags WhiteTeam and BlackTeam are used.<br>|
|» tier|body|integer|false|Optional, for Lichess admins only, used to feature on /broadcast.<br><br>* `3` for Official: normal tier<br>* `4` for Official: high tier<br>* `5` for Official: best tier<br>|
|» tiebreaks|body|[[BroadcastTiebreakExtendedCode](#schemabroadcasttiebreakextendedcode)]|false|none|
|» grouping|body|object|false|Group this broadcast along with others<br>|
|» » info|body|object|false|none|
|» » » name|body|string|false|Name of the group|
|» » » tours|body|string|false|A linebreak separated list of tournament IDs to group together.<br>|
|» » scoreGroups|body|[string]|false|This parameter is repeated with an index for each score group, like 'grouping.scoreGroups[0]=wYigbpXq,M5YHvpOX'|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» visibility|public|
|» visibility|unlisted|
|» visibility|private|
|» tier|3|
|» tier|4|
|» tier|5|
|» tiebreaks|AOB|
|» tiebreaks|APPO|
|» tiebreaks|APRO|
|» tiebreaks|ARO|
|» tiebreaks|ARO-C1|
|» tiebreaks|ARO-C2|
|» tiebreaks|ARO-M1|
|» tiebreaks|ARO-M2|
|» tiebreaks|BH|
|» tiebreaks|BH-C1|
|» tiebreaks|BH-C2|
|» tiebreaks|BH-M1|
|» tiebreaks|BH-M2|
|» tiebreaks|BPG|
|» tiebreaks|BWG|
|» tiebreaks|DE|
|» tiebreaks|FB|
|» tiebreaks|FB-C1|
|» tiebreaks|FB-C2|
|» tiebreaks|FB-M1|
|» tiebreaks|FB-M2|
|» tiebreaks|KS|
|» tiebreaks|PS|
|» tiebreaks|PS-C1|
|» tiebreaks|PS-C2|
|» tiebreaks|PS-M1|
|» tiebreaks|PS-M2|
|» tiebreaks|PTP|
|» tiebreaks|SB|
|» tiebreaks|SB-C1|
|» tiebreaks|SB-C2|
|» tiebreaks|SB-M1|
|» tiebreaks|SB-M2|
|» tiebreaks|TPR|
|» tiebreaks|WON|

> Example responses

```json
  "tour": {
    "id": "EUHb3ssn",
    "name": "Knight Invitational",
    "slug": "knight-invitational",
    "info": {},
    "createdAt": 1793058153135,
```

## Update your broadcast tournament

<a id="opIdbroadcastTourUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/broadcast/stringst/edit \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'name=string&info=%7B%22format%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tc%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22fideTC%22%3A%22standard%22%2C%22timeZone%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22location%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22players%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22website%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%22%2C%22standings%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%22%2C%22regulations%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%22%7D&markdown=string&showScores=false&showRatingDiffs=false&teamTable=false&visibility=public&players=string&teams=string&tier=3&tiebreaks=%5B%22AOB%22%5D&grouping=%7B%22info%22%3A%7B%22name%22%3A%22Chess%20Olympiad%20%7C%20Open%22%2C%22tours%22%3A%22wYigbpXq%5CnM5YHvpOX%5Cnq6ezoCXP%5Cn%22%7D%2C%22scoreGroups%22%3A%5B%22wYigbpXq%2CM5YHvpOX%22%5D%7D'
```

`POST /broadcast/{broadcastTournamentId}/edit`

Update information about a broadcast tournament that you created.
This endpoint accepts the same form data as the web form.
All fields must be populated with data. Missing fields will override the broadcast with empty data.


> Body parameter

```yaml
name: string
info:
  format: string
  tc: string
  fideTC: standard
  timeZone: string
  location: string
  players: string
  website: "http://example.com"
  standings: "http://example.com"
  regulations: "http://example.com"
markdown: string
showScores: false
showRatingDiffs: false
teamTable: false
visibility: public
players: string
teams: string
tier: 3
tiebreaks:
  - AOB
grouping:
  info:
    name: "Chess Olympiad | Open"
    tours: "wYigbpXq\nM5YHvpOX\nq6ezoCXP\n"
  scoreGroups:
    - "wYigbpXq,M5YHvpOX"
```

<h3 id="update-your-broadcast-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|broadcastTournamentId|path|string|true|The broadcast ID|
|body|body|[BroadcastForm](#schemabroadcastform)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the broadcast tournament.<br><br>Example: `Sinquefield Cup`<br>|
|» info|body|[BroadcastTourInfo](#schemabroadcasttourinfo)|false|Additional display information about the tournament|
|» markdown|body|string|false|Optional long description of the broadcast. Markdown is supported.<br>|
|» showScores|body|boolean|false|Show players scores based on game results<br>|
|» showRatingDiffs|body|boolean|false|Show player's rating diffs<br>|
|» teamTable|body|boolean|false|Show a team leaderboard. Requires WhiteTeam and BlackTeam PGN tags.<br>|
|» visibility|body|string|false|Who can view the broadcast.<br>* `public`: Default. Anyone can view the broadcast<br>* `unlisted`: Only people with the link can view the broadcast<br>* `private`: Only the broadcast owner(s) can view the broadcast<br>|
|» players|body|string|false|Optional replace player names, ratings and titles.<br><br>One line per player, formatted as such:<br><br>```txt<br>player name / FIDE ID<br>```<br><br>Example:<br><br>```txt<br>Magnus Carlsen / 1503014<br>```<br><br>Player names ignore case and punctuation, and match all possible combinations of 2 words: "Jorge Rick Vito" will match "Jorge Rick", "jorge vito", "Rick, Vito", etc.<br><br>If the player is NM or WNM, you can:<br><br>```txt<br>player name / FIDE ID / title<br>```<br><br>Alternatively, you may set tags manually, like so:<br><br>```txt<br>player name / rating / title / new name<br>```<br><br>All values are optional. Example:<br>```txt<br>Magnus Carlsen / 2863 / GM<br>YouGotLittUp / 1890 / / Louis Litt<br>```<br>|
|» teams|body|string|false|Optional: assign players to teams<br><br>One line per player, formatted as such:<br>```txt<br>Team name; Fide Id or Player name<br>```<br><br>Example:<br>```txt<br>Team Cats ; 3408230<br>Team Dogs ; Scooby Doo<br>```<br><br>By default the PGN tags WhiteTeam and BlackTeam are used.<br>|
|» tier|body|integer|false|Optional, for Lichess admins only, used to feature on /broadcast.<br><br>* `3` for Official: normal tier<br>* `4` for Official: high tier<br>* `5` for Official: best tier<br>|
|» tiebreaks|body|[[BroadcastTiebreakExtendedCode](#schemabroadcasttiebreakextendedcode)]|false|none|
|» grouping|body|object|false|Group this broadcast along with others<br>|
|» » info|body|object|false|none|
|» » » name|body|string|false|Name of the group|
|» » » tours|body|string|false|A linebreak separated list of tournament IDs to group together.<br>|
|» » scoreGroups|body|[string]|false|This parameter is repeated with an index for each score group, like 'grouping.scoreGroups[0]=wYigbpXq,M5YHvpOX'|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» visibility|public|
|» visibility|unlisted|
|» visibility|private|
|» tier|3|
|» tier|4|
|» tier|5|

## Create a broadcast round

<a id="opIdbroadcastRoundCreate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/broadcast/stringst/new \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'name=string&syncSource=push&startsAt=1356998400070&startsAfterPrevious=false&delay=0&status=new&rated=true&customScoring=%7B%22white%22%3A%7B%22win%22%3A0%2C%22draw%22%3A0%7D%2C%22black%22%3A%7B%22win%22%3A0%2C%22draw%22%3A0%7D%7D&teamCustomScoring=%7B%22win%22%3A0%2C%22draw%22%3A0%7D&period=2'
```

`POST /broadcast/{broadcastTournamentId}/new`

Create a new broadcast round to relay external games.
This endpoint accepts the same form data as the web form.

Choose one between `syncUrl`, `syncUrls`, `syncIds` and `syncUsers`, if it is missing, the broadcast needs to be fed by [pushing PGN to it](#tag/broadcasts/POST/api/broadcast/round/{broadcastRoundId}/push)


> Body parameter

```yaml
name: string
syncSource: push
startsAt: 1356998400070
startsAfterPrevious: false
delay: 0
status: new
rated: true
customScoring:
  white:
    win: 0
    draw: 0
  black:
    win: 0
    draw: 0
teamCustomScoring:
  win: 0
  draw: 0
period: 2
```

<h3 id="create-a-broadcast-round-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|broadcastTournamentId|path|string|true|The broadcast tournament ID|
|body|body|[BroadcastRoundForm](#schemabroadcastroundform)|true|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|[BroadcastRoundFormName](#schemabroadcastroundformname)|true|Name of the broadcast round.<br>Example: `Round 1`<br>|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|[BroadcastRoundFormName](#schemabroadcastroundformname)|true|Name of the broadcast round.<br>Example: `Round 1`<br>|
|» syncUrl|body|string(uri)|true|URL that Lichess will poll to get updates about the games. It must be publicly accessible from the Internet.<br><br>Example:<br>```txt<br>https://myserver.org/myevent/round-10/games.pgn<br>```<br>|
|» onlyRound|body|integer|false|Filter games by round number<br><br>Optional, only keep games from the source that match a round number.<br>It uses the PGN **Round** tag. These would match round 3:<br>```txt<br>[Round "3"]<br>[Round "3.1"]<br>```<br>If you set a round number, then games without a **Round** tag are dropped.<br><br>It only works if you chose `syncUrl` or `syncUrls` as the source.<br>|
|» slices|body|string|false|Select slices of the games<br><br>Optional. Select games based on their position in the source.<br>```txt<br>1           only select the first board<br>1-4         only select the first 4 boards<br>1,2,3,4     same as above, first 4 boards<br>11-15,21-25 boards 11 to 15, and boards 21 to 25<br>2,3,7-9     boards 2, 3, 7, 8, and 9<br>```<br>Slicing is done after filtering by round number.<br><br>It only works if you chose `syncUrl` or `syncUrls` as the source.<br>|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|[BroadcastRoundFormName](#schemabroadcastroundformname)|true|Name of the broadcast round.<br>Example: `Round 1`<br>|
|» syncUrls|body|string|true|URLs that Lichess will poll to get updates about the games, separated by newlines. They must be publicly accessible from the Internet.<br><br>Example:<br>```txt<br>https://myserver.org/myevent/round-10/game-1.pgn<br>https://myserver.org/myevent/round-10/game-2.pgn<br>```<br>|
|» onlyRound|body|integer|false|Filter games by round number<br><br>Optional, only keep games from the source that match a round number.<br>It uses the PGN **Round** tag. These would match round 3:<br>```txt<br>[Round "3"]<br>[Round "3.1"]<br>```<br>If you set a round number, then games without a **Round** tag are dropped.<br><br>It only works if you chose `syncUrl` or `syncUrls` as the source.<br>|
|» slices|body|string|false|Select slices of the games<br><br>Optional. Select games based on their position in the source.<br>```txt<br>1           only select the first board<br>1-4         only select the first 4 boards<br>1,2,3,4     same as above, first 4 boards<br>11-15,21-25 boards 11 to 15, and boards 21 to 25<br>2,3,7-9     boards 2, 3, 7, 8, and 9<br>```<br>Slicing is done after filtering by round number.<br><br>It only works if you chose `syncUrl` or `syncUrls` as the source.<br>|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|[BroadcastRoundFormName](#schemabroadcastroundformname)|true|Name of the broadcast round.<br>Example: `Round 1`<br>|
|» syncIds|body|string|true|Lichess game IDs - Up to 100 Lichess game IDs, separated by spaces.<br>|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|[BroadcastRoundFormName](#schemabroadcastroundformname)|true|Name of the broadcast round.<br>Example: `Round 1`<br>|
|» syncUsers|body|string|true|Up to 100 Lichess usernames, separated by spaces<br>|
|» syncSource|body|string|false|Where the games come from.<br>|
|» startsAt|body|integer(int64)|false|Timestamp in milliseconds of broadcast round start. Leave empty to manually start the broadcast round.<br>Example: `1356998400070`<br>|
|» startsAfterPrevious|body|boolean|false|The start date is unknown, and the round will start automatically when the previous round completes.<br>|
|» delay|body|integer|false|Delay in seconds for movements to appear on the broadcast. Leave it empty if you don't need it.<br>Example: `900` (15 min)<br>|
|» status|body|string|false|Lichess can usually detect the round status, but you can also set it manually if needed.<br>|
|» rated|body|boolean|false|Whether the round is used when calculating players' rating changes.|
|» customScoring|body|[BroadcastCustomScoring](#schemabroadcastcustomscoring)|false|Scoring overrides for wins or draws.|
|» teamCustomScoring|body|[BroadcastCustomPointsPerColor](#schemabroadcastcustompointspercolor)|false|Scoring overrides for a team match win or draw.<br>|
|» period|body|integer|false|(Only for Admins) Waiting time for each poll.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» syncSource|push|
|» syncSource|url|
|» syncSource|urls|
|» syncSource|ids|
|» syncSource|users|
|» status|new|
|» status|started|
|» status|finished|

## Update a broadcast round

<a id="opIdbroadcastRoundUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/broadcast/round/stringst/edit \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'name=string&syncSource=push&startsAt=1356998400070&startsAfterPrevious=false&delay=0&status=new&rated=true&customScoring=%7B%22white%22%3A%7B%22win%22%3A0%2C%22draw%22%3A0%7D%2C%22black%22%3A%7B%22win%22%3A0%2C%22draw%22%3A0%7D%7D&teamCustomScoring=%7B%22win%22%3A0%2C%22draw%22%3A0%7D&period=2'
```

`POST /broadcast/round/{broadcastRoundId}/edit`

Update information about a broadcast round.
This endpoint accepts the same form data as the web form.
All fields must be populated with data. Missing fields will override the broadcast with empty data.
For instance, if you omit `startDate`, then any pre-existing start date will be removed.


> Body parameter

```yaml
name: string
syncSource: push
startsAt: 1356998400070
startsAfterPrevious: false
delay: 0
status: new
rated: true
customScoring:
  white:
    win: 0
    draw: 0
  black:
    win: 0
    draw: 0
teamCustomScoring:
  win: 0
  draw: 0
period: 2
```

<h3 id="update-a-broadcast-round-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|broadcastRoundId|path|string|true|The broadcast round ID|
|patch|query|boolean|false|Only update the provided fields, leaving others unchanged|
|body|body|[BroadcastRoundForm](#schemabroadcastroundform)|true|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|[BroadcastRoundFormName](#schemabroadcastroundformname)|true|Name of the broadcast round.<br>Example: `Round 1`<br>|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|[BroadcastRoundFormName](#schemabroadcastroundformname)|true|Name of the broadcast round.<br>Example: `Round 1`<br>|
|» syncUrl|body|string(uri)|true|URL that Lichess will poll to get updates about the games. It must be publicly accessible from the Internet.<br><br>Example:<br>```txt<br>https://myserver.org/myevent/round-10/games.pgn<br>```<br>|
|» onlyRound|body|integer|false|Filter games by round number<br><br>Optional, only keep games from the source that match a round number.<br>It uses the PGN **Round** tag. These would match round 3:<br>```txt<br>[Round "3"]<br>[Round "3.1"]<br>```<br>If you set a round number, then games without a **Round** tag are dropped.<br><br>It only works if you chose `syncUrl` or `syncUrls` as the source.<br>|
|» slices|body|string|false|Select slices of the games<br><br>Optional. Select games based on their position in the source.<br>```txt<br>1           only select the first board<br>1-4         only select the first 4 boards<br>1,2,3,4     same as above, first 4 boards<br>11-15,21-25 boards 11 to 15, and boards 21 to 25<br>2,3,7-9     boards 2, 3, 7, 8, and 9<br>```<br>Slicing is done after filtering by round number.<br><br>It only works if you chose `syncUrl` or `syncUrls` as the source.<br>|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|[BroadcastRoundFormName](#schemabroadcastroundformname)|true|Name of the broadcast round.<br>Example: `Round 1`<br>|
|» syncUrls|body|string|true|URLs that Lichess will poll to get updates about the games, separated by newlines. They must be publicly accessible from the Internet.<br><br>Example:<br>```txt<br>https://myserver.org/myevent/round-10/game-1.pgn<br>https://myserver.org/myevent/round-10/game-2.pgn<br>```<br>|
|» onlyRound|body|integer|false|Filter games by round number<br><br>Optional, only keep games from the source that match a round number.<br>It uses the PGN **Round** tag. These would match round 3:<br>```txt<br>[Round "3"]<br>[Round "3.1"]<br>```<br>If you set a round number, then games without a **Round** tag are dropped.<br><br>It only works if you chose `syncUrl` or `syncUrls` as the source.<br>|
|» slices|body|string|false|Select slices of the games<br><br>Optional. Select games based on their position in the source.<br>```txt<br>1           only select the first board<br>1-4         only select the first 4 boards<br>1,2,3,4     same as above, first 4 boards<br>11-15,21-25 boards 11 to 15, and boards 21 to 25<br>2,3,7-9     boards 2, 3, 7, 8, and 9<br>```<br>Slicing is done after filtering by round number.<br><br>It only works if you chose `syncUrl` or `syncUrls` as the source.<br>|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|[BroadcastRoundFormName](#schemabroadcastroundformname)|true|Name of the broadcast round.<br>Example: `Round 1`<br>|
|» syncIds|body|string|true|Lichess game IDs - Up to 100 Lichess game IDs, separated by spaces.<br>|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|[BroadcastRoundFormName](#schemabroadcastroundformname)|true|Name of the broadcast round.<br>Example: `Round 1`<br>|
|» syncUsers|body|string|true|Up to 100 Lichess usernames, separated by spaces<br>|
|» syncSource|body|string|false|Where the games come from.<br>|
|» startsAt|body|integer(int64)|false|Timestamp in milliseconds of broadcast round start. Leave empty to manually start the broadcast round.<br>Example: `1356998400070`<br>|
|» startsAfterPrevious|body|boolean|false|The start date is unknown, and the round will start automatically when the previous round completes.<br>|
|» delay|body|integer|false|Delay in seconds for movements to appear on the broadcast. Leave it empty if you don't need it.<br>Example: `900` (15 min)<br>|
|» status|body|string|false|Lichess can usually detect the round status, but you can also set it manually if needed.<br>|
|» rated|body|boolean|false|Whether the round is used when calculating players' rating changes.|
|» customScoring|body|[BroadcastCustomScoring](#schemabroadcastcustomscoring)|false|Scoring overrides for wins or draws.|
|» teamCustomScoring|body|[BroadcastCustomPointsPerColor](#schemabroadcastcustompointspercolor)|false|Scoring overrides for a team match win or draw.<br>|
|» period|body|integer|false|(Only for Admins) Waiting time for each poll.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» syncSource|push|
|» syncSource|url|
|» syncSource|urls|
|» syncSource|ids|
|» syncSource|users|
|» status|new|
|» status|started|
|» status|finished|

## Stream an ongoing broadcast round as PGN

<a id="opIdbroadcastStreamRoundPgn"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/stream/broadcast/round/stringst.pgn \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/stream/broadcast/round/{broadcastRoundId}.pgn`

This streaming endpoint first sends all games of a broadcast round in PGN format.
Then, it waits for new moves to be played. As soon as it happens, the entire PGN of the game is sent to the stream.
The stream will also send PGNs when games are added to the round.
This is the best way to get updates about an ongoing round. Streaming means no polling,
and no pollings means no latency, and minimum impact on the server.


<h3 id="stream-an-ongoing-broadcast-round-as-pgn-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|broadcastRoundId|path|string|true|The broadcast round ID|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock comments in the PGN moves, when available.<br>Example: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>|
|comments|query|boolean|false|Include analysis comments in the PGN moves, when available.<br>Example: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] }`<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```text
[Event "Knight Invitational"]
[Site "https://lichess.org/broadcast/knight-invitational-2/final-round-2/4O3WIBf0/EMXEn9YN"]
[Date "2026.10.26"]
[White "Player 1"]
[Black "Player 2"]
[Result "*"]
[WhiteFideId "123"]
[BlackFideId "456"]
[Variant "Standard"]
[ECO "C20"]
[Opening "King's Pawn Game"]
[UTCDate "2026.10.26"]
[UTCTime "23:42:33"]
[BroadcastName "Knight Invitational 2"]
[BroadcastURL "https://lichess.org/broadcast/knight-invitational-2/final-round-2/4O3WIBf0"]
[GameURL "https://lichess.org/broadcast/knight-invitational-2/final-round-2/4O3WIBf0/EMXEn9YN"]

1. e4 e5 *


[Event "Knight Invitational"]
[Site "https://lichess.org/broadcast/knight-invitational-2/final-round-2/4O3WIBf0/airZH7mK"]
[Date "2026.10.26"]

[Black "Player 4"]

[Opening "Queen's Pawn Game"]
```

## Stream ongoing broadcast rounds of a tournament as PGN

<a id="opIdbroadcastStreamTourPgn"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/stream/broadcast/tour/stringst.pgn \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/stream/broadcast/tour/{broadcastTourId}.pgn`

For a given broadcast tournament ([example](https://lichess.org/broadcast/sparkassen-chess-trophy-2026-open-a/jfEpUuzg)),
selects all the ongoing and recently finished rounds, and sends all games of these rounds in PGN format.
Then, it waits for new moves to be played. As soon as it happens, the entire PGN of the game is sent to the stream.
The stream will also send PGNs when games are added to the rounds.
This is the best way to get updates about an ongoing broadcast tournament across all its rounds.
To stream a single round, use [this endpoint instead](#tag/broadcasts/GET/api/stream/broadcast/round/{broadcastRoundId}.pgn).


<h3 id="stream-ongoing-broadcast-rounds-of-a-tournament-as-pgn-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|broadcastTourId|path|string|true|The broadcast tournament ID. It's the last past of the tournament URL, which can be found on the broadcast page overview section.<br>[Example](https://lichess.org/broadcast/sparkassen-chess-trophy-2026-open-a/jfEpUuzg) the tournament URL is <br>https://lichess.org/broadcast/sparkassen-chess-trophy-2026-open-a/jfEpUuzg and therefore the tournament ID is `jfEpUuzg `.<br>|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock comments in the PGN moves, when available.<br>Example: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>|
|comments|query|boolean|false|Include analysis comments in the PGN moves, when available.<br>Example: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] }`<br>|

`GET /api/stream/broadcast/group/{broadcastGroupId}.pgn`

For a given broadcast group ([example](https://lichess.org/broadcast/fide-world-cadets-cup-2026/albQx5zq)),
selects all the ongoing and recently finished rounds, and sends all games of these rounds in PGN format.
Then, it waits for new moves to be played. As soon as it happens, the entire PGN of the game is sent to the stream.
The stream will also send PGNs when games are added to the rounds.
This is the best way to get updates about an ongoing broadcast with multiple concurrent rounds.
To stream a single round, use [this endpoint instead](#tag/broadcasts/GET/api/stream/broadcast/round/{broadcastRoundId}.pgn).


<h3 id="stream-ongoing-broadcast-rounds-of-a-group-as-pgn-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|broadcastGroupId|path|string|true|The broadcast group ID. It's the last past of the group URL, which can be found on the broadcast page overview section.<br>[Example](https://lichess.org/broadcast/fide-world-cadets-cup-2026-o12/round-9/FUQFT39K) the group URL is <br>https://lichess.org/broadcast/fide-world-cadets-cup-2026/albQx5zq and therefore the group ID is `albQx5zq`.<br>|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock comments in the PGN moves, when available.<br>Example: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>|
|comments|query|boolean|false|Include analysis comments in the PGN moves, when available.<br>Example: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] }`<br>|

## Create a bulk pairing

<a id="opIdbulkPairingCreate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/bulk-pairing \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'players=string&clock.limit=0&clock.increment=0&days=1&pairAt=0&startClocksAt=0&rated=false&variant=standard&fen=rnbqkbnr%2Fpppppppp%2F8%2F8%2F8%2F8%2FPPPPPPPP%2FRNBQKBNR%20w%20KQkq%20-%200%201&message=Your%20game%20with%20%7Bopponent%7D%20is%20ready%3A%20%7Bgame%7D.&rules=noAbort'
```

`POST /api/bulk-pairing`

Schedule many games at once, up to 24h in advance.
OAuth tokens are required for all paired players, with the `challenge:write` scope.
You can schedule up to 500 games every 10 minutes. [Contact us](mailto:contact@lichess.org) if you need higher limits.
If games have a real-time clock, each player must have only one pairing.
For correspondence games, players can have multiple pairings within the same bulk.

**The entire bulk is rejected if:**
  - a token is missing
  - a token is present more than once (except in correspondence)
  - a token lacks the `challenge:write` scope
  - a player account is closed
  - a player is paired more than once (except in correspondence)
  - a bulk is already scheduled to start at the same time with the same player
  - you have 20 scheduled bulks
  - you have 1000 scheduled games

Partial bulks are never created. Either it all fails, or it all succeeds.
When it fails, it does so with an error message explaining the issue.
Failed bulks are not counted in the rate limiting, they are free.
Fix the issues, manually or programmatically, then retry to schedule the bulk.
A successful bulk creation returns a JSON bulk document. Its ID can be used for further operations.


> Body parameter

```yaml
players: string
clock.limit: 0
clock.increment: 0
days: 1
pairAt: 0
startClocksAt: 0
rated: false
variant: standard
fen: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1
message: "Your game with {opponent} is ready: {game}."
rules: noAbort
```

<h3 id="create-a-bulk-pairing-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|Parameters of the pairings|
|» players|body|string|false|OAuth tokens of all the players to pair, with the syntax `tokenOfWhitePlayerInGame1:tokenOfBlackPlayerInGame1,tokenOfWhitePlayerInGame2:tokenOfBlackPlayerInGame2,...`.<br>The 2 tokens of the players of a game are separated with `:`. The first token gets the white pieces. Games are separated with `,`.<br>Up to 1000 tokens can be sent, for a max of 500 games.<br>Each token must be included at most once.<br>Example: `token1:token2,token3:token4,token5:token6`<br>|
|» clock.limit|body|integer|false|Clock initial time in seconds. Example: `600`<br>|
|» clock.increment|body|integer|false|Clock increment in seconds. Example: `2`<br>|
|» days|body|integer|false|Days per turn. For correspondence games only.|
|» pairAt|body|integer(int64)|false|Date at which the games will be created as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.<br>Up to 7 days in the future.<br>Omit, or set to current date and time, to start the games immediately.<br>Example: `1612289869919`<br>|
|» startClocksAt|body|integer(int64)|false|Date at which the clocks will be automatically started as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.<br>Up to 7 days in the future.<br>Note that the clocks can start earlier than specified, if players start making moves in the game.<br>If omitted, the clocks will not start automatically.<br>Example: `1612289869919`<br>|
|» rated|body|boolean|false|Game is rated and impacts players ratings|
|» variant|body|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|none|
|» fen|body|[FromPositionFEN](#schemafrompositionfen)|false|Custom initial position (in X-FEN). Variant must be standard, fromPosition, or chess960 (if a valid 960 starting position), and the game cannot be rated.|
|» message|body|string|false|Message that will be sent to each player, when the game is created.  It is sent from your user account.<br>`{opponent}` and `{game}` are placeholders that will be replaced with the opponent and the game URLs.<br>You can omit this field to send the default message,<br>but if you set your own message, it must at least contain the `{game}` placeholder.<br>You can also disable messages entirely, by setting the template to `{noMessage}`. You will then need to notify the players yourself about their games.<br>|
|» rules|body|string|false|Extra game rules separated by commas.<br>Example: `noAbort,noRematch`<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» days|1|
|» days|2|
|» days|3|
|» days|5|
|» days|7|
|» days|10|
|» days|14|
|» variant|standard|
|» variant|chess960|
|» variant|crazyhouse|
|» variant|antichess|
|» variant|atomic|
|» variant|horde|
|» variant|kingOfTheHill|
|» variant|racingKings|
|» variant|threeCheck|
|» variant|fromPosition|
|» rules|noAbort|
|» rules|noRematch|
|» rules|noGiveTime|
|» rules|noClaimWin|
|» rules|noEarlyDraw|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "rd6H425E",
  "games": [
    {
      "id": "efC9e9X2",
      "white": "sai",
      "black": "nushi"
    }
  ],
  "variant": "standard",
  "rated": false,
  "pairAt": 1793058153917,
  "startClocksAt": null,
  "scheduledAt": 1793058153917,
  "pairedAt": null,
  "clock": {
    "limit": 300,
    "increment": 0
  }
}
```

```json
  "error": "string"

```

## Manually start clocks

<a id="opIdbulkPairingStartClocks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/bulk-pairing/5IrD6Gzz/start-clocks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/bulk-pairing/{id}/start-clocks`

Immediately start all clocks of the games of a bulk pairing.
This overrides the `startClocksAt` value of an existing bulk pairing.
If the games have not yet been created (`bulk.pairAt` is in the future), then this does nothing.
If the clocks have already started (`bulk.startClocksAt` is in the past), then this does nothing.


<h3 id="manually-start-clocks-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|none|

```json
{
  "ok": true
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

|200|OK|The clocks of the games of a bulk pairing were successfully started.|[Ok](#schemaok)|

`DELETE /api/bulk-pairing/{id}`

## Export games of a bulk pairing

<a id="opIdbulkPairingIdGamesGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/bulk-pairing/5IrD6Gzz/games \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/bulk-pairing/{id}/games`

Download games of a bulk in PGN or [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) format, depending on the request `Accept` header.


<h3 id="export-games-of-a-bulk-pairing-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Accept|header|string|false|Specify the desired response format.<br>Use `application/x-chess-pgn` to get the games in PGN format.<br>Use `application/x-ndjson` to get the games in ndjson format. [Read about ndjson here](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) and how you can parse it in Javascript.<br>|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|moves|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN moves.|
|pgnInJson|query|boolean|false|Include the full PGN within the JSON response, in a `pgn` field.|
|tags|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN tags.|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock status when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>Or in a `clocks` JSON field, as centisecond integers, depending on the response type.<br>|
|evals|query|boolean|false|Include analysis evaluations and comments, when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] } a3 { [%eval -1.09] }`<br>Or in an `analysis` JSON field, depending on the response type.<br>|
|accuracy|query|boolean|false|Include [accuracy percent](https://lichess.org/page/accuracy) of each player, when available. Only available in JSON.<br>|
|opening|query|boolean|false|Include the opening name.<br>Example: `[Opening "King's Gambit Accepted, King's Knight Gambit"]`<br>|
|division|query|boolean|false|Plies which mark the beginning of the middlegame and endgame.<br>Only available in JSON<br>|
|literate|query|boolean|false|Insert textual annotations in the PGN about the opening, analysis variations, mistakes, and game termination.<br>Example: `5... g4? { (-0.98 → 0.60) Mistake. Best move was h6. } (5... h6 6. d4 Ne7 7. g3 d5 8. exd5 fxg3 9. hxg3 c6 10. dxc6)`<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Accept|application/x-chess-pgn|
|Accept|application/x-ndjson|

```text
[Date "2026.10.26"]
[Round "-"]
[White "Sai"]
[Black "Nushi"]
[Result "*"]
[GameId "efC9e9X2"]
[UTCDate "2026.10.26"]
[UTCTime "23:42:33"]
[WhiteElo "1639"]
[BlackElo "1085"]
[Variant "Standard"]
[TimeControl "300+0"]
[Termination "Unterminated"]

 *

```

## Create a challenge

<a id="opIdchallengeCreate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/challenge/LeelaChess \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'clock.limit=300&clock.increment=1&rated=false&color=white&variant=standard&fen=rnbqkbnr%2Fpppppppp%2F8%2F8%2F8%2F8%2FPPPPPPPP%2FRNBQKBNR%20w%20KQkq%20-%200%201&keepAliveStream=true&rules=noAbort'
```

`POST /api/challenge/{username}`

Challenge someone to play. The targeted player can choose to accept or decline.
If the challenge is accepted, you will be notified on the [event stream](#tag/board/GET/api/board/game/stream/{gameId})
that a new game has started. The game ID will be the same as the challenge ID.
Challenges for realtime games (not correspondence) expire after 20s if not accepted.
To prevent that, use the `keepAliveStream` flag described below.


> Body parameter

```yaml
clock.limit: 300
clock.increment: 1
rated: false
color: white
variant: standard
fen: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1
keepAliveStream: true
rules: noAbort
```

<h3 id="create-a-challenge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|Parameters of the challenge|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» clock.limit|body|integer|true|Clock initial time in seconds. If empty, a correspondence game is created. Valid values are 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, and any multiple of 60 up to 10800 (3 hours).|
|» clock.increment|body|integer|true|Clock increment in seconds. If empty, a correspondence game is created.|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» days|body|integer|true|Days per move, for correspondence games. Clock settings must be omitted.|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» rated|body|boolean|false|Game is rated and impacts players ratings|
|» color|body|[ChallengeColor](#schemachallengecolor)|false|Which color you get to play|
|» variant|body|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|none|
|» fen|body|[FromPositionFEN](#schemafrompositionfen)|false|Custom initial position (in X-FEN). Variant must be standard, fromPosition, or chess960 (if a valid 960 starting position), and the game cannot be rated.|
|» keepAliveStream|body|boolean|false|If set, the response is streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).<br>The challenge is kept alive until the connection is closed by the client.<br>When the challenge is accepted, declined or canceled, a message of the form `{"done":"accepted"}` is sent,<br>then the connection is closed by the server.<br>If not set, the response is not streamed, and the challenge expires after 20s if not accepted.<br>|
|» rules|body|string|false|Extra game rules separated by commas.<br>Example: `noAbort,noRematch`<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» days|1|
|» days|2|
|» days|3|
|» days|5|
|» days|7|
|» days|10|
|» days|14|
|» color|white|
|» color|black|
|» color|random|
|» variant|standard|
|» variant|chess960|
|» variant|crazyhouse|
|» variant|antichess|
|» variant|atomic|
|» variant|horde|
|» variant|kingOfTheHill|
|» variant|racingKings|
|» variant|threeCheck|
|» variant|fromPosition|
|» rules|noAbort|
|» rules|noRematch|
|» rules|noGiveTime|
|» rules|noClaimWin|
|» rules|noEarlyDraw|

`POST /api/challenge/{challengeId}/cancel`

Cancel a challenge you sent, or aborts the game if the challenge was accepted, but the game was not yet played.

## Open-ended challenge

<a id="opIdchallengeOpen"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/challenge/open \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d 'rated=false&clock.limit=300&clock.increment=1&days=1&variant=standard&fen=rnbqkbnr%2Fpppppppp%2F8%2F8%2F8%2F8%2FPPPPPPPP%2FRNBQKBNR%20w%20KQkq%20-%200%201&name=string&rules=noRematch&users=string&expiresAt=0'
```

`POST /api/challenge/open`

Create a challenge that any 2 players can join.
Share the URL of the challenge. the first 2 players to click it will be paired for a game.
The response body also contains `whiteUrl` and `blackUrl`.
You can control which color each player gets by giving them these URLs,
instead of the main challenge URL.
Open challenges expire after 24h.
If the challenge creation is [authenticated with OAuth2](#description/authentication),
then you can use the [challenge cancel endpoint](#tag/challenges/POST/api/challenge/{challengeId}/cancel) to cancel it.
To directly pair 2 known players, use [this endpoint](#tag/bulk-pairings/GET/api/bulk-pairing) instead.


> Body parameter

```yaml
rated: false
clock.limit: 300
clock.increment: 1
days: 1
variant: standard
fen: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1
name: string
rules: noRematch
users: string
expiresAt: 0
```

<h3 id="open-ended-challenge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|Parameters of the game|
|» rated|body|boolean|false|Game is rated and impacts players ratings|
|» clock.limit|body|integer|false|Clock initial time in seconds. If empty, a correspondence game is created.|
|» clock.increment|body|integer|false|Clock increment in seconds. If empty, a correspondence game is created.|
|» days|body|integer|false|Days per turn. For correspondence challenges.|
|» variant|body|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|none|
|» fen|body|[FromPositionFEN](#schemafrompositionfen)|false|Custom initial position (in X-FEN). Variant must be standard, fromPosition, or chess960 (if a valid 960 starting position), and the game cannot be rated.|
|» name|body|string|false|Optional name for the challenge, that players will see on the challenge page.|
|» rules|body|string|false|Extra game rules separated by commas.<br>Example: `noRematch,noGiveTime`<br>The `noAbort` rule is available for Lichess admins only<br>|
|» users|body|string|false|Optional pair of usernames, separated by a comma.<br>If set, only these users will be allowed to join the game.<br>The first username gets the white pieces.<br>Example: `Username1,Username2`<br>|
|» expiresAt|body|integer(int64)|false|Timestamp in milliseconds to expire the challenge. Defaults to 24h after creation. Can't be more than 2 weeks after creation.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» days|1|
|» days|2|
|» days|3|
|» days|5|
|» days|7|
|» days|10|
|» days|14|
|» variant|standard|
|» variant|chess960|
|» variant|crazyhouse|
|» variant|antichess|
|» variant|atomic|
|» variant|horde|
|» variant|kingOfTheHill|
|» variant|racingKings|
|» variant|threeCheck|
|» variant|fromPosition|
|» rules|noRematch|
|» rules|noGiveTime|
|» rules|noClaimWin|
|» rules|noEarlyDraw|
|» rules|noAbort|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "Bm9vM8bj",
  "url": "https://lichess.org/game/Bm9vM8bj",
  "status": "created",
  "challenger": null,
  "destUser": null,

    "key": "standard",
    "name": "Standard",
    "short": "Std"
  },
  "rated": false,

    "type": "unlimited"
  },

  },

```


## Start clocks of a game

<a id="opIdchallengeStartClocks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://lichess.org/api/challenge/string/start-clocks?token1=string' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/challenge/{gameId}/start-clocks`

Start the clocks of a game immediately, even if a player has not yet made a move.
Requires the OAuth tokens of both players with `challenge:write` scope.
If the clocks have already started, the call will have no effect.

For AI games with only one player, omit the `token2` parameter.


<h3 id="start-clocks-of-a-game-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|gameId|path|string|true|none|
|token1|query|string|true|OAuth token of a player|
|token2|query|string|false|OAuth token of the other player. Omit for AI games that have only one player.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ok": true
}
```

<h3 id="start-clocks-of-a-game-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The clock of a game was successfully started.|[Ok](#schemaok)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: challenge:write )
</aside>

## Admin challenge tokens

<a id="opIdadminChallengeTokens"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/token/admin-challenge \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'users=thibault%2Cneio%2Clizen2%2Clizen3&description=FIDE%20tournament%20XYZ'
```

`POST /api/token/admin-challenge`

**This endpoint can only be used by Lichess administrators. It will not work if you do not have the appropriate permissions.** Tournament organizers should instead use [OAuth](#tag/OAuth) to obtain `challenge:write` tokens from users in order to perform bulk pairing.*
Create and obtain `challenge:write` tokens for multiple users.
If a similar token already exists for a user, it is reused. This endpoint is idempotent.


> Body parameter

```yaml
users: "thibault,neio,lizen2,lizen3"
description: FIDE tournament XYZ
```

<h3 id="admin-challenge-tokens-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» users|body|string|true|Usernames separated with commas|
|» description|body|string|true|User visible description of the token|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "bobby": "lip_bobby_secret",
  "boris": "lip_boris_secret",
  "mary": "lip_mary_secret"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="admin-challenge-tokens-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The `challenge:write` tokens of each user|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|The creation of the tokens failed.|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<h3 id="admin-challenge-tokens-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|**additionalProperties**|string|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

OAuth2 ( Scopes: web:mod )
</aside>

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-external-engine">External engine</h1>

**This API is in alpha and subject to change.**

Use or provide external engine analysis.

External engines can provide analysis on pages like the
[analysis board](https://lichess.org/analysis), running as a service
outside of the browser, or even on a different machine.

## Create external engine

<a id="opIdapiExternalEngineCreate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/external-engine \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Stockfish 15",
    "maxThreads": 8,
    "maxHash": 2048,
    "variants": [
      "chess"
    ],
    "providerSecret": "Dee3uwieZei9ahpaici9bee2yahsai0K",
    "providerData": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/external-engine`

Registers a new external engine for the user. It can then be selected
and used on the analysis board.
After registering, the provider should start waiting for analyis requests.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Stockfish 15",
  "maxThreads": 8,
  "maxHash": 2048,
  "variants": [
    "chess"
  ],
  "providerSecret": "Dee3uwieZei9ahpaici9bee2yahsai0K",
  "providerData": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-external-engine-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ExternalEngineRegistration](#schemaexternalengineregistration)|true|A new external engine registration.|
|» name|body|string|true|Display name of the engine.|
|» maxThreads|body|integer|true|Maximum number of available threads.|
|» maxHash|body|integer|true|Maximum available hash table size, in MiB.|
|» variants|body|[[UciVariant](#schemaucivariant)]|false|Optional list of supported chess variants.|
|» providerSecret|body|string|true|A random token that can be used to<br>[wait for analysis requests](#tag/external-engine/POST/api/external-engine/work)<br>and provide analysis.<br><br>The engine provider should securely generate a random string.<br><br>The token will not be readable again, even by the user.<br><br>The analysis provider can register multiple engines with the same<br>token, even for different users, and wait for analysis requests<br>from any of them. In this case, the request must not be made via<br>CORS, so that the token is not revealed to any of the users.<br>|
|» providerData|body|string|false|Arbitrary data that the engine provider can use for identification<br>or bookkeeping.<br><br>Users can read this information, but updating it requires knowing<br>or changing the `providerSecret`.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» variants|chess|
|» variants|crazyhouse|
|» variants|antichess|
|» variants|atomic|
|» variants|horde|
|» variants|kingofthehill|
|» variants|racingkings|
|» variants|3check|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "eei_Bfh2VIM1m3rh",
  "name": "Stockfish 17",
  "userId": "bobby",
  "maxThreads": 8,
  "maxHash": 2048,
  "variants": [
    "chess"
  ],
  "providerData": null,
  "clientSecret": "ees_AKzFjHT0F7CBLvxt"
}
```

<h3 id="create-external-engine-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The registered engine.|[ExternalEngine](#schemaexternalengine)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: engine:write )
</aside>

## Analyse with external engine

<a id="opIdapiExternalEngineAnalyse"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/external-engine/eei_aTKImBJOnv6j/analyse \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "clientSecret": "ees_mdF2hK0hlKGSPeC6",
    "work": {
      "movetime": 1,
      "sessionId": "string",
      "threads": 1,
      "hash": 1,
      "multiPv": 1,
      "variant": "chess",
      "initialFen": "string",
      "moves": [
        "string"
      ]
    }
  }'
```

`POST /api/external-engine/{id}/analyse`

**Endpoint: `https://engine.lichess.ovh/api/external-engine/{id}/analyse`**

Request analysis from an external engine.
Response content is streamed as [newline delimited JSON](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).
The properties are based on the [UCI specification](https://backscattering.de/chess/uci/#engine).
Analysis stops when the client goes away, the requested limit
is reached, or the provider goes away.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "clientSecret": "ees_mdF2hK0hlKGSPeC6",
  "work": {
    "movetime": 1,
    "sessionId": "string",
    "threads": 1,
    "hash": 1,
    "multiPv": 1,
    "variant": "chess",
    "initialFen": "string",
    "moves": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
}
```

<h3 id="analyse-with-external-engine-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The external engine id.|
|body|body|object|true|Engine credentials and analysis request.|
|» clientSecret|body|string|true|none|
|» work|body|[ExternalEngineWork](#schemaexternalenginework)|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "time": 2,
  "depth": 1,
  "nodes": 20,
  "pvs": [
    {
      "moves": [
        "e4e5",
        "f6d5"
      ],
      "cp": 13,

  ]
}
```

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|nodes|integer|true|none|Number of nodes visited so far|

|» mate|integer|false|none|Evaluation in signed moves to mate, from White's point of view|

`POST /api/external-engine/work`

**Endpoint: `https://engine.lichess.ovh/api/external-engine/work`**

Wait for an analysis requests to any of the external engines that

## Answer analysis request

<a id="opIdapiExternalEngineSubmit"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/external-engine/work/aingoohiJee2sius \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
  -d 'info multipv 1 depth 20 seldepth 30 time 1373 nodes 1494341 score cp 47 hashfull 594 nps 1088376 tbhits 0 pv d2d4 d7d5 c2c4 e7e6 b1c3 f8b4 c4d5 e6d5 g1f3 g8f6 c1g5 h7h6 g5f6 d8f6 d1b3 c7c5 e2e3 b8c6 d4c5 e8g8 f1d3'
```

`POST /api/external-engine/work/{id}`

**Endpoint: `https://engine.lichess.ovh/api/external-engine/work/{id}`**

Submit a stream of analysis as [UCI output](https://backscattering.de/chess/uci/#engine-info).
* The engine should always be in `UCI_Chess960` mode.
* `UCI_AnalyseMode` enabled if available.
* Engine produces `info` with at least:
  - `depth`
  - `multipv` (between 1 and 5)
  - `score`
  - `nodes`
  - `time`
  - `pv`
* Engine finally sends `bestmove`:
  - with a move or `(none)`
  - optionally, with `ponder` move

The endpoint may close the connection at any time, indicating that
the requester has gone away and analysis should be stopped.


> Body parameter

```text
info multipv 1 depth 20 seldepth 30 time 1373 nodes 1494341 score cp 47 hashfull 594 nps 1088376 tbhits 0 pv d2d4 d7d5 c2c4 e7e6 b1c3 f8b4 c4d5 e6d5 g1f3 g8f6 c1g5 h7h6 g5f6 d8f6 d1b3 c7c5 e2e3 b8c6 d4c5 e8g8 f1d3
```

<h3 id="answer-analysis-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|string|true|Analysis results|

<h3 id="answer-analysis-request-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Thanks|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>
