## Export one game

<a id="opIdgamePgn"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/game/export/stringst \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /game/export/{gameId}`

Download one game in either PGN or JSON format.
Ongoing games are delayed by 3 moves, as to prevent cheat bots from using this API.


<h3 id="export-one-game-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Accept|header|string|false|Specify the desired response format.<br>Use `application/x-chess-pgn` to get the games in PGN format.<br>Use `application/json` to get the games in JSON format.<br>|
|gameId|path|string|true|The game ID|
|moves|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN moves.|
|pgnInJson|query|boolean|false|Include the full PGN within the JSON response, in a `pgn` field.|
|tags|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN tags.|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock status when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>Or in a `clocks` JSON field, as centisecond integers, depending on the response type.<br>|
|evals|query|boolean|false|Include analysis evaluations and comments, when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] } a3 { [%eval -1.09] }`<br>Or in an `analysis` JSON field, depending on the response type.<br>|
|accuracy|query|boolean|false|Include [accuracy percent](https://lichess.org/page/accuracy) of each player, when available. Only available in JSON.<br>|
|opening|query|boolean|false|Include the opening name.<br>Example: `[Opening "King's Gambit Accepted, King's Knight Gambit"]`<br>|
|division|query|boolean|false|Plies which mark the beginning of the middlegame and endgame.<br>Only available in JSON<br>|
|literate|query|boolean|false|Insert textual annotations in the PGN about the opening, analysis variations, mistakes, and game termination.<br>Example: `5... g4? { (-0.98 → 0.60) Mistake. Best move was h6. } (5... h6 6. d4 Ne7 7. g3 d5 8. exd5 fxg3 9. hxg3 c6 10. dxc6)`<br>|
|withBookmarked|query|boolean|false|Add a `bookmarked: true` JSON field when the logged in user has bookmarked the game.<br>The response type must be set to `application/x-ndjson` by the request `Accept` header.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Accept|application/x-chess-pgn|
|Accept|application/json|

  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/game/{gameId}/chat`

Get the messages posted in the public spectator chat of a game.

Games also have a private players chat, which only the 2 players can see.


<h3 id="fetch-the-spectator-game-chat-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|gameId|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "lines": [
    {
      "text": "Have fun!",
      "user": "iryna"
    },
    {
      "text": "Good luck",
      "user": "fatima"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="fetch-the-spectator-game-chat-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The messages posted in the chat.|[SpectatorGameChat](#schemaspectatorgamechat)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Export ongoing game of a user

<a id="opIdapiUserCurrentGame"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/user/string/current-game \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/user/{username}/current-game`

Download the ongoing game, or the last game played, of a user.
Available in either PGN or JSON format.
Ongoing games are delayed by 3 moves, as to prevent cheat bots from using this API.


<h3 id="export-ongoing-game-of-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Accept|header|string|false|Specify the desired response format.<br>Use `application/x-chess-pgn` to get the games in PGN format.<br>Use `application/json` to get the games in JSON format.<br>|
|username|path|string|true|none|
|moves|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN moves.|
|pgnInJson|query|boolean|false|Include the full PGN within the JSON response, in a `pgn` field.|
|tags|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN tags.|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock status when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>Or in a `clocks` JSON field, as centisecond integers, depending on the response type.<br>|
|evals|query|boolean|false|Include analysis evaluations and comments, when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] } a3 { [%eval -1.09] }`<br>Or in an `analysis` JSON field, depending on the response type.<br>|
|accuracy|query|boolean|false|Include [accuracy percent](https://lichess.org/page/accuracy) of each player, when available. Only available in JSON.<br>|
|opening|query|boolean|false|Include the opening name.<br>Example: `[Opening "King's Gambit Accepted, King's Knight Gambit"]`<br>|
|division|query|boolean|false|Plies which mark the beginning of the middlegame and endgame.<br>Only available in JSON<br>|
|literate|query|boolean|false|Insert textual annotations in the PGN about the opening, analysis variations, mistakes, and game termination.<br>Example: `5... g4? { (-0.98 → 0.60) Mistake. Best move was h6. } (5... h6 6. d4 Ne7 7. g3 d5 8. exd5 fxg3 9. hxg3 c6 10. dxc6)`<br>|

## Export games of a user

<a id="opIdapiGamesUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/games/user/string \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/games/user/{username}`

Download all games of any user in PGN or [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) format.
Games are sorted by reverse chronological order (most recent first).
We recommend streaming the response, for it can be very long.
<https://lichess.org/@/german11> for instance has more than 500,000 games.
The game stream is throttled, depending on who is making the request:
  - Anonymous request: 20 games per second
  - [OAuth2 authenticated](#description/authentication) request: 30 games per second
  - Authenticated, downloading your own games: 60 games per second


<h3 id="export-games-of-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Accept|header|string|false|Specify the desired response format.<br>Use `application/x-chess-pgn` to get the games in PGN format.<br>Use `application/x-ndjson` to get the games in ndjson format. [Read about ndjson here](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) and how you can parse it in Javascript.<br>|
|username|path|string|true|The user name.|
|since|query|integer|false|Download games played since this timestamp. Defaults to account creation date.|
|until|query|integer|false|Download games played until this timestamp. Defaults to now.|
|max|query|integer|false|How many games to download. Leave empty to download all games.|
|vs|query|string|false|[Filter] Only games played against this opponent|
|rated|query|boolean|false|[Filter] Only rated (`true`) or casual (`false`) games|
|perfType|query|[PerfType](#schemaperftype)|false|[Filter] Only games in these speeds or variants.<br>Multiple perf types can be specified, separated by a comma.<br>Example: blitz,rapid,classical<br>|
|color|query|string|false|[Filter] Only games played as this color.|
|analysed|query|boolean|false|[Filter] Only games with or without a computer analysis available|
|moves|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN moves.|
|pgnInJson|query|boolean|false|Include the full PGN within the JSON response, in a `pgn` field. The response type must be set to `application/x-ndjson` by the request `Accept` header.|
|tags|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN tags.|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock status when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>Or in a `clocks` JSON field, as centisecond integers, depending on the response type.<br>|
|evals|query|boolean|false|Include analysis evaluations and comments, when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] } a3 { [%eval -1.09] }`<br>Or in an `analysis` JSON field, depending on the response type.<br>|
|accuracy|query|boolean|false|Include [accuracy percent](https://lichess.org/page/accuracy) of each player, when available. Only available in JSON.<br>|
|opening|query|boolean|false|Include the opening name.<br>Example: `[Opening "King's Gambit Accepted, King's Knight Gambit"]`<br>|
|division|query|boolean|false|Plies which mark the beginning of the middlegame and endgame.<br>Only available in JSON<br>|
|ongoing|query|boolean|false|Ongoing games are delayed by a few seconds ranging from 3 to 60 depending on the time control, as to prevent cheat bots from using this API.|
|finished|query|boolean|false|Include finished games. Set to `false` to only get ongoing games.|
|literate|query|boolean|false|Insert textual annotations in the PGN about the opening, analysis variations, mistakes, and game termination.<br>Example: `5... g4? { (-0.98 → 0.60) Mistake. Best move was h6. } (5... h6 6. d4 Ne7 7. g3 d5 8. exd5 fxg3 9. hxg3 c6 10. dxc6)`<br>|
|lastFen|query|boolean|false|Include the X-FEN notation of the last position of the game.<br>The response type must be set to `application/x-ndjson` by the request `Accept` header.<br>|
|withBookmarked|query|boolean|false|Add a `bookmarked: true` JSON field when the logged in user has bookmarked the game.<br>The response type must be set to `application/x-ndjson` by the request `Accept` header.<br>|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort order of the games.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Accept|application/x-chess-pgn|
|Accept|application/x-ndjson|
|perfType|ultraBullet|
|perfType|bullet|
|perfType|blitz|
|perfType|rapid|
|perfType|classical|
|perfType|correspondence|
|perfType|chess960|
|perfType|crazyhouse|
|perfType|antichess|
|perfType|atomic|
|perfType|horde|
|perfType|kingOfTheHill|
|perfType|racingKings|
|perfType|threeCheck|
|color|white|
|color|black|
|sort|dateAsc|
|sort|dateDesc|

[Site "https://lichess.org/game/BLce71aZ"]

Rf1 Kh7 19. Nf3 Bh6 20. Ng5+ Bxg5 21. hxg5 fxe4 22. Rh1 e3 23. Qb3 e4 24. Nxd4 Qg4 25. Ne2 Nf5 26. Qxb7+ Kh8 27. Qxa7 exd3 28. O-O-O Qxe2 29. Kb1 Rxc4 30. Ka1 d2 31. Rxh5+ gxh5 32. Rb1 Rc1 0-1

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The games of the user.|Inline|

<h3 id="export-games-of-a-user-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[GamePgn](#schemagamepgn)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|[GameJson](#schemagamejson)|false|none|none|

|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2

## Export games by IDs

<a id="opIdgamesExportIds"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/games/export/_ids \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d 'TJxUmbWK,4OtIh2oh,ILwozzRZ'
```

`POST /api/games/export/_ids`

Download games by IDs in PGN or [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) format, depending on the request `Accept` header.
Games are sorted by reverse chronological order (most recent first)
The method is `POST` so a longer list of IDs can be sent in the request body.
300 IDs can be submitted.
Ongoing games are delayed by 3 moves, as to prevent cheat bots from using this API.


> Body parameter

```text
TJxUmbWK,4OtIh2oh,ILwozzRZ

[Read about ndjson here](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) and how you can parse it in Javascript.<br>|
|moves|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN moves.|
|pgnInJson|query|boolean|false|Include the full PGN within the JSON response, in a `pgn` field.|
|tags|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN tags.|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock status when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>Or in a `clocks` JSON field, as centisecond integers, depending on the response type.<br>|
|evals|query|boolean|false|Include analysis evaluations and comments, when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] } a3 { [%eval -1.09] }`<br>Or in an `analysis` JSON field, depending on the response type.<br>|
|accuracy|query|boolean|false|Include [accuracy percent](https://lichess.org/page/accuracy) of each player, when available. Only available in JSON.<br>|
|opening|query|boolean|false|Include the opening name.<br>Example: `[Opening "King's Gambit Accepted, King's Knight Gambit"]`<br>|
|division|query|boolean|false|Plies which mark the beginning of the middlegame and endgame.<br>Only available in JSON<br>|
|literate|query|boolean|false|Insert textual annotations in the PGN about the opening, analysis variations, mistakes, and game termination.<br>Example: `5... g4? { (-0.98 → 0.60) Mistake. Best move was h6. } (5... h6 6. d4 Ne7 7. g3 d5 8. exd5 fxg3 9. hxg3 c6 10. dxc6)`<br>|
|body|body|string|true|Game IDs separated by commas. Up to 300.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Accept|application/x-chess-pgn|
|Accept|application/x-ndjson|

## Stream games of users

<a id="opIdgamesByUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/stream/games-by-users \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
  -d 'string'
```

`POST /api/stream/games-by-users`

Stream the games played between a list of users, in real time.
Only games where **both players** are part of the list are included.
The stream emits an event each time a game is started or finished.
To also get all current ongoing games at the beginning of the stream, use the `withCurrentGames` flag.
Games are streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).
Maximum number of users: 300.
The method is `POST` so a longer list of IDs can be sent in the request body.


> Body parameter

```text
string
```

<h3 id="stream-games-of-users-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|withCurrentGames|query|boolean|false|Include the already started games at the beginning of the stream.|
|body|body|string|true|Up to 300 user IDs separated by commas.<br>Example: `thibault,maia1,maia5`<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": "tNIsADH0",
    "rated": false,
    "variant": "standard",
    "speed": "blitz",
    "perf": "blitz",
    "createdAt": 1793058158936,
    "status": 20,
    "statusName": "started",
    "players": {
      "white": {
        "userId": "fatima",
        "rating": 1089
      },
      "black": {
        "userId": "iryna",
        "rating": 1861
      }
    },
    "clock": {
      "initial": 300,
      "increment": 0
    }
  }
]
```

<h3 id="stream-games-of-users-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The stream of the games played between the users.|[GameStream](#schemagamestream)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Stream games by IDs

<a id="opIdgamesByIds"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/stream/games/myAppName-someRandomId \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
  -d 'string'
```

`POST /api/stream/games/{streamId}`

Creates a stream of games from an arbitrary streamId, and a list of game IDs.
The stream first outputs the games that already exists, then emits an event each time a game is started or finished.
Games are streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).
Maximum number of games: 500 for anonymous requests, or 1000 for [OAuth2 authenticated](#description/authentication) requests.
While the stream is open, it is possible to [add new game IDs to watch](#tag/games/POST/api/stream/games/{streamId}/add).


> Body parameter

```text
string
```

<h3 id="stream-games-by-ids-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|streamId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|string|true|Up to 500 or 1000 game IDs separated by commas.<br>Example: `gameId01,gameId02,gameId03`<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json

    }

## Stream moves of a game

<a id="opIdstreamGame"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/stream/game/LuGQwhBb \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/stream/game/{id}`

Stream positions and moves of any ongoing game, in [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).
A description of the game is sent as a first message.
Then a message is sent each time a move is played.
Finally, a description of the game is sent when it finishes, and the stream is closed.
Ongoing games are delayed by 3 moves, as to prevent cheat bots from using this API.
No more than 8 game streams can be opened at the same time from the same IP address.


<h3 id="stream-moves-of-a-game-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|none|

## Import one game

<a id="opIdgameImport"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/import \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'pgn=string'
```

`POST /api/import`

Import a game from PGN. See <https://lichess.org/paste>.
Rate limiting: 200 games per hour for OAuth requests, 100 games per hour for anonymous requests.
To broadcast ongoing games, consider [pushing to a broadcast instead](#tag/broadcasts/POST/api/broadcast/round/{broadcastRoundId}/push).
To analyse a position or a line, just construct an analysis board URL (most standard tags supported if URL-encoded):
[https://lichess.org/analysis/pgn/e4_e5_Nf3_Nc6_Bc4_Bc5_Bxf7+](https://lichess.org/analysis/pgn/e4_e5_Nf3_Nc6_Bc4_Bc5_Bxf7+)


> Body parameter

```yaml
pgn: string
```

<h3 id="import-one-game-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|A single game to import|
|» pgn|body|string|false|The PGN. It can contain only one game. Most standard tags are supported.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "PYtlOPwg",
  "url": "https://lichess.org/game/PYtlOPwg"
}
```

<h3 id="import-one-game-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The game was successfully imported.|Inline|

<h3 id="import-one-game-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|The game ID|
|url|string(uri)|false|none|The game URL|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2
</aside>

## Export your bookmarked games

<a id="opIdapiExportBookmarks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/games/export/bookmarks \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/games/export/bookmarks`

Download all games bookmarked by you, in PGN or [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) format.
Games are sorted by reverse chronological order (most recent first).
We recommend streaming the response, for it can be very long.


<h3 id="export-your-bookmarked-games-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Accept|header|string|false|Specify the desired response format.<br>Use `application/x-chess-pgn` to get the games in PGN format.<br>Use `application/x-ndjson` to get the games in ndjson format. [Read about ndjson here](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) and how you can parse it in Javascript.<br>|
|since|query|integer|false|Download games bookmarked since this timestamp. Defaults to account creation date.|
|until|query|integer|false|Download games bookmarked until this timestamp. Defaults to now.|
|max|query|integer|false|How many bookmarked games to download. Leave empty to download all bookmarked games.|
|moves|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN moves.|
|pgnInJson|query|boolean|false|Include the full PGN within the JSON response, in a `pgn` field. The response type must be set to `application/x-ndjson` by the request `Accept` header.|
|tags|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN tags.|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock status when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>Or in a `clocks` JSON field, as centisecond integers, depending on the response type.<br>|
|evals|query|boolean|false|Include analysis evaluations and comments, when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] } a3 { [%eval -1.09] }`<br>Or in an `analysis` JSON field, depending on the response type.<br>|
|accuracy|query|boolean|false|Include [accuracy percent](https://lichess.org/page/accuracy) of each player, when available. Only available in JSON.<br>|
|opening|query|boolean|false|Include the opening name.<br>Example: `[Opening "King's Gambit Accepted, King's Knight Gambit"]`<br>|
|division|query|boolean|false|Plies which mark the beginning of the middlegame and endgame.<br>Only available in JSON<br>|
|literate|query|boolean|false|Insert textual annotations in the PGN about the opening, analysis variations, mistakes, and game termination.<br>Example: `5... g4? { (-0.98 → 0.60) Mistake. Best move was h6. } (5... h6 6. d4 Ne7 7. g3 d5 8. exd5 fxg3 9. hxg3 c6 10. dxc6)`<br>|
|lastFen|query|boolean|false|Include the X-FEN notation of the last position of the game.<br>The response type must be set to `application/x-ndjson` by the request `Accept` header.<br>|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort order of the bookmarks.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Accept|application/x-chess-pgn|
|Accept|application/x-ndjson|
|sort|dateAsc|
|sort|dateDesc|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"[Event \"casual blitz game\"]\n[Site \"https://lichess.org/game/tNIsADH0\"]\n[Date \"2026.10.26\"]\n[Round \"-\"]\n[White \"Fatima\"]\n[Black \"Iryna\"]\n[Result \"0-1\"]\n[GameId \"tNIsADH0\"]\n[UTCDate \"2026.10.26\"]\n[UTCTime \"23:42:38\"]\n[WhiteElo \"1089\"]\n[BlackElo \"1861\"]\n[Variant \"Standard\"]\n[TimeControl \"300+0\"]\n[Termination \"Normal\"]\n\n1. e4 e5 0-1\n"
```

<h3 id="export-your-bookmarked-games-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The bookmarked games of the user.|Inline|

<h3 id="export-your-bookmarked-games-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[GamePgn](#schemagamepgn)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|[GameJson](#schemagamejson)|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2
</aside>

## Bookmark a game

<a id="opIdbookmarkToggle"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/bookmark/5IrD6Gzz \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /bookmark/{gameId}`

Add or remove a bookmark on a game, for the logged in user.
By default, the bookmark is toggled: added if absent, removed if present.
Use the `v` parameter to explicitly set the bookmark instead, making the request idempotent.
Bookmarked games can be downloaded with the [export your bookmarked games](#tag/games/GET/api/games/export/bookmarks) endpoint.


<h3 id="bookmark-a-game-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|gameId|path|string|true|none|
|v|query|boolean|false|Explicitly set the bookmark instead of toggling it.<br>`true` adds the bookmark, `false` removes it.<br>|

<h3 id="bookmark-a-game-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The bookmark was successfully added or removed.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|204|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: preference:write )
</aside>

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-opening-explorer">Opening Explorer</h1>

Lookup positions from the [Lichess opening explorer](https://lichess.org/analysis#explorer).

Runs <https://github.com/lichess-org/lila-openingexplorer>.

> [!important]
> The hostname for these endpoints is `explorer.lichess.org` and not `lichess.org`.


## Masters database

<a id="opIdopeningExplorerMaster"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/masters \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /masters`

**Endpoint: <https://explorer.lichess.org/masters>**

Example: `curl https://explorer.lichess.org/masters?play=d2d4,d7d5,c2c4,c7c6,c4d5`


<h3 id="masters-database-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fen|query|string|false|X-FEN of the root position|
|play|query|string|false|Comma separated sequence of legal moves in UCI notation.<br>Play additional moves starting from `fen`.<br>Required to find an opening name, if `fen` is not an exact match<br>for a named position.<br>|
|since|query|integer|false|Include only games from this year or later|
|until|query|integer|false|Include only games from this year or earlier|
|moves|query|integer|false|Number of most common moves to display|
|topGames|query|integer|false|Number of top games to display|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "white": 1927,
  "draws": 5215,
  "black": 1469,
  "moves": [
    {
      "uci": "c6d5",
      "san": "cxd5",
      "averageRating": 2412,
      "white": 1927,
      "draws": 5215,
      "black": 1468,
      "game": null,
      "opening": null
    },

## Lichess games

<a id="opIdopeningExplorerLichess"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/lichess \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /lichess`

**Endpoint: <https://explorer.lichess.org/lichess>**

Aggregated rated games from all Lichess players.

Example: `curl https://explorer.lichess.org/lichess?variant=standard&speeds=blitz,rapid,classical&ratings=2200,2500&fen=rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR%20w%20KQkq%20-%200%201`


<h3 id="lichess-games-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|variant|query|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|Variant|
|fen|query|string|false|X-FEN or EPD of the root position|
|play|query|string|false|Comma separated sequence of legal moves in UCI notation.<br>Play additional moves starting from `fen`.<br>Required to find an opening name, if `fen` is not an exact match<br>for a named position.<br>|
|speeds|query|[[Speed](#schemaspeed)]|false|Comma separated list of game speeds to filter by|
|ratings|query|[integer]|false|Comma separated list of ratings groups to filter by.<br>Each group ranges from its value to the next higher<br>group in the enum (`0` from 0 to 999, `1000` from 1000 to 1199,<br>..., `2500` from 2500 to any rating above).<br>|
|since|query|string|false|Include only games from this month or later|
|until|query|string|false|Include only games from this month or earlier|
|moves|query|integer|false|Number of most common moves to display|
|topGames|query|integer|false|Maximum number of top games to display.<br><br>Due to the way banned users are handled internally, the response may<br>contain fewer games than expected.<br>|
|recentGames|query|integer|false|Maximum number of recent games to display.<br><br>Due to the way banned users are handled internally, the response may<br>contain fewer games than expected.<br>|
|history|query|boolean|false|Optionally retrieve history|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|variant|standard|
|variant|chess960|
|variant|crazyhouse|
|variant|antichess|
|variant|atomic|
|variant|horde|
|variant|kingOfTheHill|
|variant|racingKings|
|variant|threeCheck|
|variant|fromPosition|
|speeds|ultraBullet|
|speeds|bullet|
|speeds|blitz|
|speeds|rapid|
|speeds|classical|
|speeds|correspondence|
|ratings|0|
|ratings|1000|
|ratings|1200|
|ratings|1400|
|ratings|1600|
|ratings|1800|
|ratings|2000|
|ratings|2200|
|ratings|2500|

## Player games

<a id="opIdopeningExplorerPlayer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://lichess.org/player?player=revoof&color=white' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /player`

**Endpoint: <https://explorer.lichess.org/player>**

Games of a Lichess player.

Responds with a stream of [newline delimited JSON](#description/streaming-with-nd-json). Will start indexing
on demand, immediately respond with the current results, and stream
more updates until indexing is complete. The stream is throttled
and deduplicated. Empty lines may be sent to avoid timeouts.

Will index new games at most once per minute, and revisit previously
ongoing games at most once every day.

Example: `curl https://explorer.lichess.org/player?player=revoof&color=white&play=d2d4,d7d5&recentGames=1`


<h3 id="player-games-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|player|query|string|true|Username or ID of the player|
|color|query|string|true|Look for games with *player* on the given side|
|variant|query|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|Variant|
|fen|query|string|false|X-FEN of the root position|
|play|query|string|false|Comma separated sequence of legal moves in UCI notation.<br>Play additional moves starting from `fen`.<br>Required to find an opening name, if `fen` is not an exact match<br>for a named position.<br>|
|speeds|query|[[Speed](#schemaspeed)]|false|Comma separated list of game speeds to look for|
|modes|query|[string]|false|Comma separated list of modes|
|since|query|string|false|Include only games from this month or later|
|until|query|string|false|Include only games from this month or earlier|
|moves|query|integer|false|Number of most common moves to display|
|recentGames|query|integer|false|Number of recent games to display|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|color|white|
|color|black|
|variant|standard|
|variant|chess960|
|variant|crazyhouse|
|variant|antichess|
|variant|atomic|
|variant|horde|
|variant|kingOfTheHill|
|variant|racingKings|
|variant|threeCheck|
|variant|fromPosition|
|speeds|ultraBullet|
|speeds|bullet|
|speeds|blitz|
|speeds|rapid|
|speeds|classical|
|speeds|correspondence|
|modes|casual|
|modes|rated|

**Endpoint: `https://explorer.lichess.org/masters/pgn/{gameId}`**

|---|---|---|---|---|
|gameId|path|string|true|none|

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-puzzles">Puzzles</h1>

Fetch and solve [puzzles](https://lichess.org/training), view your puzzle history and dashboard.

Our collection of puzzles is in the public domain, you can [download it here](https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles).
For a list of our [puzzle themes](https://lichess.org/training/themes) with their description, check out the [theme translation file](https://github.com/ornicar/lila/blob/master/translation/source/puzzleTheme.xml).

## Get a new puzzle

<a id="opIdapiPuzzleNext"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/puzzle/next \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/puzzle/next`

Get a random Lichess puzzle in JSON format.

If authenticated, only returns puzzles that the user has never seen before.

**DO NOT** use this endpoint to enumerate puzzles for mass download. Instead, download the [full public puzzle database](https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles).


<h3 id="get-a-new-puzzle-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|angle|query|string|false|The theme or opening to filter puzzles with.<br><br>Available themes are listed in [the lichess source code](https://github.com/ornicar/lila/blob/master/translation/source/puzzleTheme.xml) and [the lichess training themes hyperlinks](https://lichess.org/training/themes).<br>|
|difficulty|query|string|false|The desired puzzle difficulty, relative to the authenticated user puzzle rating, or 1500 if anonymous.|
|color|query|string|false|The color to play. Better left empty to automatically get 50% white.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|difficulty|easiest|
|difficulty|easier|
|difficulty|normal|
|difficulty|harder|
|difficulty|hardest|
|color|white|
|color|black|

## Get multiple puzzles at once

<a id="opIdapiPuzzleBatchSelect"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/puzzle/batch/mix \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/puzzle/batch/{angle}`

Get a batch of random Lichess puzzles in JSON format.

If authenticated, only returns puzzles that the user has never seen before.

**DO NOT** use this endpoint to enumerate puzzles for mass download. Instead, download the [full public puzzle database](https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles).


<h3 id="get-multiple-puzzles-at-once-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|angle|path|string|true|The theme or opening to filter puzzles with. Recommended: `mix`.<br><br>Available themes are listed in [the lichess source code](https://github.com/ornicar/lila/blob/master/translation/source/puzzleTheme.xml) and [the lichess training themes hyperlinks](https://lichess.org/training/themes).<br>|
|difficulty|query|string|false|The desired puzzle difficulty, relative to the authenticated user puzzle rating, or 1500 if anonymous.|
|nb|query|integer|false|How many puzzles to fetch. Just set it to `1` if you only need one puzzle.<br>|
|color|query|string|false|The color to play. Better left empty to automatically get 50% white.<br>Currently only works when `nb=1`.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|difficulty|easiest|
|difficulty|easier|
|difficulty|normal|
|difficulty|harder|
|difficulty|hardest|
|color|white|
|color|black|

## Solve multiple puzzles at once

<a id="opIdapiPuzzleBatchSolve"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/puzzle/batch/mix \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "solutions": [
      {
        "id": "string",
        "win": true,
        "rated": true
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/puzzle/batch/{angle}`

Set puzzles as solved and update ratings.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "solutions": [
    {
      "id": "string",
      "win": true,
      "rated": true
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="solve-multiple-puzzles-at-once-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|angle|path|string|true|The theme or opening of the solved puzzles.<br><br>Available themes are listed in [the lichess source code](https://github.com/ornicar/lila/blob/master/translation/source/puzzleTheme.xml) and [the lichess training themes hyperlinks](https://lichess.org/training/themes).<br>|
|nb|query|integer|false|When > 0, the response includes a new puzzle batch with that many puzzles.<br><br>This is equivalent to calling [/api/puzzle/batch/{angle}](#tag/puzzles/GET/api/puzzle/batch/{angle}),<br>and can sometimes save a request.<br>|
|body|body|[PuzzleBatchSolveRequest](#schemapuzzlebatchsolverequest)|true|List of solved puzzles|
|» solutions|body|[object]|false|none|
|» » id|body|string|false|none|
|» » win|body|boolean|false|none|
|» » rated|body|boolean|false|none|

## Get your puzzle activity

<a id="opIdapiPuzzleActivity"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/puzzle/activity \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/puzzle/activity`

Download your puzzle activity in [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) format.
Puzzle activity is sorted by reverse chronological order (most recent first)
We recommend streaming the response, for it can be very long.


<h3 id="get-your-puzzle-activity-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|max|query|integer|false|How many entries to download. Leave empty to download all activity.|
|before|query|integer|false|Download entries before this timestamp. Defaults to now. Use `before` and `max` for pagination.|
|since|query|integer|false|Download entries since this timestamp. Defaults to account creation date.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "date": 1793058159900,
  "win": true,
  "puzzle": {
    "id": "0haqU",
    "rating": 1167,
    "plays": 24913,
    "solution": [
      "d4d3",
      "e4c5",
      "d3c2",
      "c5b7",
      "c2c1q"
    ],

      "endgame",

      "discoveredAttack"
    ],
    "fen": "6k1/1q3p2/5prp/2b5/3pN3/1PP2P1P/2Q1R1P1/6K1 b - - 0 1",
    "lastMove": "f2f3"
  }
}
```

## Get puzzles to replay

<a id="opIdapiPuzzleReplay"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/puzzle/replay/0/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/puzzle/replay/{days}/{theme}`

Gets the puzzle IDs of remaining puzzles to re-attempt in JSON format.

<h3 id="get-puzzles-to-replay-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|days|path|integer|true|How many days to look back when aggregating puzzle results. 30 is sensible.|
|theme|path|string|true|The theme or opening to filter puzzles with.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "replay": {
    "days": 90,
    "theme": "mix",
    "nb": 5,
    "remaining": [
      "8cQU4",
      "DqEoW",
      "7Ex6n",
      "2NMq3",
      "CHCKm"
    ]
  },
  "angle": {
    "key": "mix",
    "name": "Puzzle Themes",
    "desc": "A mix of everything. You don't know what to expect, so be ready for anything! Just like in real games."
  }
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="get-puzzles-to-replay-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The requested puzzles to replay.|[PuzzleReplay](#schemapuzzlereplay)|
|404|Not Found|No puzzles to replay were found|Inline|

<h3 id="get-puzzles-to-replay-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **404**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|error|string|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: puzzle:read )
</aside>

## Get your puzzle dashboard

<a id="opIdapiPuzzleDashboard"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/puzzle/dashboard/1 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/puzzle/dashboard/{days}`

Download your [puzzle dashboard](https://lichess.org/training/dashboard/30/dashboard) as JSON.
Also includes all puzzle themes played, with aggregated results.
Allows re-creating the [improvement/strengths](https://lichess.org/training/dashboard/30/improvementAreas) interfaces.

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|days|path|integer|true|How many days to look back when aggregating puzzle results. 30 is sensible.|

## Get the storm dashboard of a player

<a id="opIdapiStormDashboard"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/storm/dashboard/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/storm/dashboard/{username}`

Download the [storm dashboard](https://lichess.org/storm/dashboard/mrbasso) of any player as JSON.
Contains the aggregated highscores, and the history of storm runs aggregated by days.
Use `?days=0` if you only care about the highscores.


<h3 id="get-the-storm-dashboard-of-a-player-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|Username of the player|
|days|query|integer|false|How many days of history to return|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "high": {
    "day": 0,
    "week": 0,
    "month": 0,
    "allTime": 33
  },
  "days": [
    {
      "_id": "2025/2/8",
      "score": 1,
      "moves": 1,
      "errors": 0,
      "combo": 1,

}

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The storm dashboard of a player.|[PuzzleStormDashboard](#schemapuzzlestormdashboard)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

This operation does not require authentication

## Create and join a puzzle race

<a id="opIdracerPost"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/racer \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/racer`

Create a new private [puzzle race](https://lichess.org/racer).
The Lichess user who creates the race must join the race page,
and manually start the race when enough players have joined.
- <https://lichess.org/racer>


> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "ss8p6",
  "url": "https://lichess.org/racer/ss8p6"
}
```

<h3 id="create-and-join-a-puzzle-race-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The new puzzle race.|[PuzzleRacer](#schemapuzzleracer)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: racer:write )
</aside>

## Get puzzle race results

<a id="opIdracerGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/racer/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/racer/{id}`

Get the results of a [puzzle race](https://lichess.org/racer).
Returns information about players, puzzles, and the current status of the race.
- <https://lichess.org/racer>

Note that Lichess puzzle races are not persisted, and are only available
for 30 minutes. After that delay, they are permanently deleted.


<h3 id="get-puzzle-race-results-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The puzzle race ID|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-relations">Relations</h1>

## Follow a player

<a id="opIdfollowUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/rel/follow/thibault \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/rel/follow/{username}`

Follow a player, adding them to your list of Lichess friends.


<h3 id="follow-a-player-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ok": true
}
```

<h3 id="follow-a-player-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The player was successfully added.|[Ok](#schemaok)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: follow:write )
</aside>

## Unfollow a player

<a id="opIdunfollowUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/rel/unfollow/thibault \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/rel/unfollow/{username}`

Unfollow a player, removing them from your list of Lichess friends.


<h3 id="unfollow-a-player-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ok": true
}
```

<h3 id="unfollow-a-player-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The player was successfully removed.|[Ok](#schemaok)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: follow:write )
</aside>

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-simuls">Simuls</h1>

Access simuls played on Lichess.
<https://lichess.org/simul>


## Get current simuls

<a id="opIdapiSimul"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/simul \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/simul`

Get recently created, started, finished, simuls.
Created and finished simul lists are not exhaustives, only those with
strong enough host will be listed, the same filter is used to display simuls on https://lichess.org/simul.
When [authenticated with OAuth2](#description/authentication), the pending list will be populated with your created, but unstarted simuls.

<h3 id="get-current-simuls-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of simuls.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-current-simuls-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pending|[[Simul](#schemasimul)]|false|none|none|
|created|[[Simul](#schemasimul)]|false|none|none|
|started|[[Simul](#schemasimul)]|false|none|none|
|finished|[[Simul](#schemasimul)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-studies">Studies</h1>

Access Lichess studies.
<https://lichess.org/study>


## Export one study chapter

<a id="opIdstudyChapterPgn"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/study/stringst/stringst.pgn \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/study/{studyId}/{chapterId}.pgn`

Download one study chapter in PGN format.
If authenticated, then all public, unlisted, and private study chapters are read.
If not, only public (non-unlisted) study chapters are read.


<h3 id="export-one-study-chapter-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|studyId|path|string|true|The study ID|
|chapterId|path|string|true|The chapter ID|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock comments in the PGN moves, when available.<br>Example: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>|
|comments|query|boolean|false|Include analysis and annotator comments in the PGN moves, when available.<br>Example: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] } a3 { White is in a pickle. }`<br>|
|variations|query|boolean|false|Include non-mainline moves, when available.<br>Example: `4. d4 Bb4+ (4... Nc6 5. Nf3 Bb4+ 6. Bd2 (6. Nbd2 O-O 7. O-O) 6... Bd6) 5. Nd2`<br>|
|orientation|query|boolean|false|Add a `Orientation` PGN tag with the chapter predefined orientation.<br>Example: `[Orientation "white"]`<br>|

## Create a new Study

<a id="opIdapiStudyPost"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/study \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'name=string&visibility=unlisted&flair=string&computer=nobody&explorer=nobody&cloneable=nobody&shareable=nobody&chat=nobody&sticky=true&description=false'
```

`POST /api/study`

Create a [study](https://lichess.org/study), and a new empty chapter within it.
You can make up to 30 new studies per day.


> Body parameter

```yaml
name: string
visibility: unlisted
flair: string
computer: nobody
explorer: nobody
cloneable: nobody
shareable: nobody
chat: nobody
sticky: true
description: false
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-study-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|Parameters of the study|
|» name|body|string|true|The study name.|
|» visibility|body|string|true|Who can view the study.<br>* `public`: Default. Anyone can view the study, it appears on public listings<br>* `unlisted`: Only people with the link can view the study, it doesn't appear on public listings<br>* `private`: Only the study members can view the study<br>|
|» flair|body|[Flair](#schemaflair)|false|See [available flair list and images](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/flair)|
|» computer|body|[StudyUserSelection](#schemastudyuserselection)|true|none|
|» explorer|body|[StudyUserSelection](#schemastudyuserselection)|true|none|
|» cloneable|body|[StudyUserSelection](#schemastudyuserselection)|true|none|
|» shareable|body|[StudyUserSelection](#schemastudyuserselection)|true|none|
|» chat|body|[StudyUserSelection](#schemastudyuserselection)|true|none|
|» sticky|body|boolean|false|Keep everyone on the same chapter and position.|
|» description|body|boolean|false|Add pinned study comment right under the board.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» visibility|public|
|» visibility|unlisted|
|» visibility|private|
|» computer|nobody|
|» computer|owner|
|» computer|contributor|
|» computer|member|
|» computer|everyone|
|» explorer|nobody|
|» explorer|owner|
|» explorer|contributor|
|» explorer|member|
|» explorer|everyone|
|» cloneable|nobody|
|» cloneable|owner|
|» cloneable|contributor|
|» cloneable|member|
|» cloneable|everyone|
|» shareable|nobody|
|» shareable|owner|
|» shareable|contributor|
|» shareable|member|
|» shareable|everyone|
|» chat|nobody|
|» chat|owner|
|» chat|contributor|
|» chat|member|
|» chat|everyone|

}
```

## Import PGN into a study

<a id="opIdapiStudyImportPGN"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/study/string/import-pgn \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'pgn=string&name=string&orientation=white&variant=standard&mode=practice'
```

`POST /api/study/{studyId}/import-pgn`

Imports arbitrary PGN into an existing [study](https://lichess.org/study). Creates a new chapter in the study.
If the PGN contains multiple games (separated by 2 or more newlines)
then multiple chapters will be created within the study.
Note that a study can contain at most 64 chapters.


> Body parameter

```yaml
pgn: string
name: string
orientation: white
variant: standard
mode: practice
```

<h3 id="import-pgn-into-a-study-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|studyId|path|string|true|ID of the study|
|body|body|object|true|Parameters of the import|
|» pgn|body|string|true|PGN to import. Can contain multiple games separated by 2 or more newlines.<br>|
|» name|body|string|false|Name of the new chapter.<br>If not specified, or if multiple chapters are created, the names will be inferred from the PGN tags.<br>|
|» orientation|body|string|false|Board orientation.<br>If not specified, the orientation is automatically determined.<br>|
|» variant|body|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|none|
|» mode|body|string|false|Analysis mode.<br>If not specified, Normal analysis.<br>* practice - Practise with Computer<br>* conceal - Hide next moves<br>* gamebook - Interactive lesson<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» orientation|white|
|» orientation|black|
|» variant|standard|
|» variant|chess960|
|» variant|crazyhouse|
|» variant|antichess|
|» variant|atomic|
|» variant|horde|
|» variant|kingOfTheHill|
|» variant|racingKings|
|» variant|threeCheck|
|» variant|fromPosition|
|» mode|practice|
|» mode|conceal|
|» mode|gamebook|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "chapters": [
    {
      "id": "dLpkgwla",
      "name": "Paul Morphy - Duke Karl / Count Isouard",
      "players": [
        {
          "name": "Paul Morphy"
        },
        {
          "name": "Duke Karl / Count Isouard"
        }
      ],
      "status": "1-0"
    },
    {
      "id": "lIlpub3T",
      "name": "Alice - Bob",
      "players": [
        {
          "name": "Alice"
        },
        {
          "name": "Bob"
        }
      ],
      "status": "1-0"
    }
  ],
  "error": null
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="import-pgn-into-a-study-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The chapters that were created.|[StudyImportPgnChapters](#schemastudyimportpgnchapters)|
|400|Bad Request|The creation of the chapter(s) failed.|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: study:write )
</aside>

## Update PGN tags of a study chapter

<a id="opIdapiStudyChapterTags"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/study/stringst/stringst/tags \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'pgn=string'
```

`POST /api/study/{studyId}/{chapterId}/tags`

Add, update and delete the PGN tags of a study.
By providing a list of PGN tags in the usual PGN format, you can:
- Add new tags if the chapter doesn't have them yet
- Update existing chapter tags
- Delete existing chapter tags, by providing a tag with an empty value.

The chapter keeps the tags that you don't provide.


> Body parameter

```yaml
pgn: string
```

<h3 id="update-pgn-tags-of-a-study-chapter-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|studyId|path|string|true|The study ID|
|chapterId|path|string|true|The chapter ID|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» pgn|body|string|true|PGN text containing the tags. Only the tags are used. Moves are just ignored.<br>|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-pgn-tags-of-a-study-chapter-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Tags updated successfully, if the chapter exists and you are authorized the update the study.|None|
|400|Bad Request|The request body was invalid, such as missing or malformed PGN tag data.|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|204|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: study:write )
</aside>

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-tablebase">Tablebase</h1>

Lookup positions from the [Lichess tablebase server](https://lichess.org/blog/W3WeMyQAACQAdfAL/7-piece-syzygy-tablebases-are-complete).

> [!important]
> The hostname for these endpoints is `tablebase.lichess.org` and not `lichess.org`.


## Tablebase lookup

<a id="opIdtablebaseStandard"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://lichess.org/standard?fen=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /standard`

**Endpoint: <https://tablebase.lichess.org>**

Example: `curl http://tablebase.lichess.org/standard?fen=4k3/6KP/8/8/8/8/7p/8_w_-_-_0_1`


<h3 id="tablebase-lookup-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fen|query|string|true|X-FEN of the position. Underscores allowed.|
|dtc|query|string|false|When to query the tablebase for `dtc` values. The default is<br>`auxiliary`, i.e., only when the position is not covered by one of the<br>other tablebases.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|dtc|never|
|dtc|auxiliary|
|dtc|always|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json

  "variant_loss": false,

  "dtc": null,

      "zeroing": true,

      "checkmate": false,

      "uci": "h7h8r",
      "san": "h8=R+",
      "zeroing": true,

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-teams">Teams</h1>

Access and manage Lichess teams and their members.
<https://lichess.org/team>


## Get team swiss tournaments

<a id="opIdapiTeamSwiss"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/team/coders/swiss
```

`GET /api/team/{teamId}/swiss`

Get all swiss tournaments of a team.
Tournaments are sorted by reverse chronological order of start date (last starting first).
Tournaments are streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).


<h3 id="get-team-swiss-tournaments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|teamId|path|string|true|none|
|max|query|integer|false|How many tournaments to download.|
|status|query|[SwissStatus](#schemaswissstatus)|false|[Filter] Only swiss tournaments in this current state.<br>|
|createdBy|query|string|false|[Filter] Only swiss tournaments created by a given user.<br>|
|name|query|string|false|[Filter] Only swiss tournaments with a given name.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|created|
|status|started|
|status|finished|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "f6P3a60W",
  "createdBy": "lichess",
  "startsAt": "2026-10-29T23:30:00Z",
  "name": "Rapid Increment",
  "clock": {
    "limit": 480,
    "increment": 2
  },
  "variant": "standard",
  "round": 0,
  "nbRounds": 7,
  "nbPlayers": 0,
  "nbOngoing": 0,
  "status": "created",
  "nextRound": {
    "at": "2026-10-29T23:30:00Z",
    "in": 258438
  },
  "verdicts": {
    "list": [
      {
        "condition": "≥ 8 rated Rapid games",
        "verdict": "ok"
      },
      {
        "condition": "Play your games",
        "verdict": "ok"
      }
    ],
    "accepted": true
  },
  "rated": true
}
```

<h3 id="get-team-swiss-tournaments-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of Swiss tournaments of a team.|[SwissTournament](#schemaswisstournament)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

      "name": "The House Discord Server",
      "description": "![House logo](https://i.postimg.cc/FR9bXyJd/23-House-Logox6-small.png)\r\n\r\n##\r\n\r\nWe are the **House**, a Lichess team for chess and variant players. We’ve won 134 Bundesliga events and five straight season titles since 2020. With 20,000+ members from amateurs to GMs, we value fair play and sportsmanship. Our tournament schedule consists of Bundesliga excitement complemented by multiple variant team battles throughout the week.\r\n\r\nAre you seeking a team that offers both competitive play and a welcoming environment? Look no further than our community. We compete in Lichess Bundesliga tournaments every Thursday and Sunday against top-tier opponents. But the excitement doesn't stop there: our team also engages in variant team tournaments, offering a variety of chess experiences to suit your preferences.\r\n\r\nExplore our unique Puzzle Packs, a collection of puzzles selected from team's Bundesliga games. The latest edition is waiting you [here](https://lichess.org/study/YSwTDVB6) and our full archive is accessible [here](https://lichess.org/study/by/TheHouseDiscord/newest).\r\n\r\n***\r\n\r\n# **Team News & Updates**\r\n- Jan 1: Happy New year! Read about our [journey of 2024 in the forum](https://lichess.org/forum/team-the-house-discord-server/year-of-2024).\r\n\r\n- Sep 22: Things are heating up in the **House Multi-Variant Championship 2025**. Who’s making the Final Four? Follow along on the [forum](https://lichess.org/forum/team-the-house-discord-server/hmvc-2025-pairings-and-results?page=1).\r\n\r\n- Oct 12: Back-to-back **Bundesliga** victories! Props to @satunnainen, @caternion, and @markamp for carrying the team [tonight](https://lichess.org/tournament/vIZ1HsYG).\r\n\r\nCheck out our [upcoming team tournaments](https://lichess.org/team/the-house-discord-server/tournaments).\r\n\r\n***\r\n\r\n# **Lichess Bundesliga**\r\n\r\nThe House joined the [Lichess Bundesliga](https://lichess.org/@/lichess/blog/announcing-the-lichess-bundesliga/X4da-RAA) in [April 2020](https://lichess.org/tournament/oGeaCHx7). After winning the inaugural season, we achieved three consecutive championships by 2022, claimed our fourth title in 2023, and we triumped again in 2024. Five titles in a row! Now we aim for a sixth. Whether you’re a strong player or a newcomer seeking a community with a legacy, The House awaits.\r\n\r\nBundesliga tournaments occur twice weekly, on **Thursdays** and **Sundays**, starting at 18:00 UTC. They offer a valuable opportunity to face formidable opponents and stregthen our team spirit.\r\n\r\nCheck out the results: [all-time scores](https://rochadeeuropa.de/ewige-q-bundesliga-tabelle/), current [season 2025](https://rochadeeuropa.de/lichess-2025/), and relive our victories in [season 2024](https://rochadeeuropa.de/lichess-2024/), [season 2023](https://rochadeeuropa.de/lichess-2023), [season 2022](https://rochadeeuropa.de/lichess-2022), [season 2021](https://rochadeeuropa.de/lichess-2021), and [season 2020](https://rochadeeuropa.de/lichess-2020). The journey isn’t over – join us as we aim for even greater heights!\r\n\r\n***\r\n\r\n# **Discord**\r\n\r\nWe have a Discord server – a chat platform for chess and variants. It's a great place to discuss chess, learn a new variant or deepen your knowledge on your favourite variants! We host group calls during team tournaments, play bughouse on voice chat, explore other games, and more.\r\n\r\nJoin us there! https://discord.gg/RhWgzcC\r\n\r\n***\r\n\r\n# **Contact**\r\n\r\nGot a question? Want to learn more about The House? Reach out to @TheHouseDiscord. Are you a team tournament organizer? ## Teams of a player

<a id="opIdteamOfUsername"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/team/of/thibault \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/team/of/{username}`

All the teams a player is a member of.
Teams that hide their player list are only included if you also belong to the team.

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of teams the player is a member of.|Inline|

<h3 id="teams-of-a-player-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[Team](#schemateam)]|false|none|none|

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2

## Get members of a team

<a id="opIdteamIdUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/team/coders/users \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/team/{teamId}/users`

Members are sorted by reverse chronological order of joining the team (most recent first).
OAuth is only required if the list of members is private.
Up to 5,000 users are streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).


<h3 id="get-members-of-a-team-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|teamId|path|string|true|none|
|full|query|boolean|false|Full user documents with performance ratings.<br>This limits the response to 1,000 users.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "name": "Yulia",
  "title": "NM",
  "id": "yulia",
  "url": "https://lichess.org/@/Yulia",
  "joinedTeamAt": 1792241704904
}
```

<h3 id="get-members-of-a-team-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of users in the team.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-members-of-a-team-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|joinedTeamAt|integer(int64)|false|none|none|
|id|string|true|none|none|
|name|string|true|none|none|
|flair|[Flair](#schemaflair)|false|none|See [available flair list and images](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/flair)|
|title|[Title](#schematitle)|false|none|only appears if the user is a titled player or a bot user|
|patron|[Patron](#schemapatron)|false|none|**Deprecated.** Use patronColor value instead to determine if player is a patron.<br>|
|patronColor|[PatronColor](#schemapatroncolor)|false|none|Players can choose a color for their Patron wings.<br>See [here for the color mappings](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/blob/master/ui/lib/css/abstract/_patron-colors.scss).<br><br>The presence of this field indicates the player is an active Patron.<br>|
|url|string(uri)|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|title|GM|
|title|WGM|
|title|IM|
|title|WIM|
|title|FM|
|title|WFM|
|title|NM|
|title|CM|
|title|WCM|
|title|WNM|
|title|LM|
|title|BOT|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: team:read )
</aside>

## Get team Arena tournaments

<a id="opIdapiTeamArena"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/team/string/arena
```

`GET /api/team/{teamId}/arena`

Get all Arena tournaments relevant to a team.
Tournaments are sorted by reverse chronological order of start date (last starting first).
Tournaments are streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).


<h3 id="get-team-arena-tournaments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|teamId|path|string|true|ID of the team|
|max|query|integer|false|How many tournaments to download.|
|status|query|[ArenaStatusName](#schemaarenastatusname)|false|[Filter] Only arena tournaments in this current state.<br>|
|createdBy|query|string|false|[Filter] Only arena tournaments created by a given user.<br>|
|name|query|string|false|[Filter] Only arena tournaments with a given name.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|created|
|status|started|
|status|finished|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

}

|---|---|---|---|---|

## Join a team

<a id="opIdteamIdJoin"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/team/coders/join \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'message=stringstringstringstringstring&password=string'
```

`POST /team/{teamId}/join`

Join a team.
If the team requires a password but the `password` field is incorrect,
then the call fails with `403 Forbidden`.
Similarly, if the team join policy requires a confirmation but the
`message` parameter is not given, then the call fails with
`403 Forbidden`.


> Body parameter

```yaml
message: stringstringstringstringstring
password: string
```

<h3 id="join-a-team-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|teamId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» message|body|string|false|Required if team manually reviews admission requests.|
|» password|body|string|false|Optional password, if the team requires one.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ok": true
}
```

<h3 id="join-a-team-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The request to join a team was successfully sent.|[Ok](#schemaok)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: team:write )
</aside>

curl https://lichess.org/team/updates \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

curl https://lichess.org/team/updates/coders \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"

## Send a team update

<a id="opIdteamIdPmAll"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/team/coders/pm-all \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'message=string'
```

`POST /team/{teamId}/pm-all`

Send a team update to all members of a team.
You must be a team leader with the "Updates" permission.


> Body parameter

```yaml
message: string
```

<h3 id="send-a-team-update-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|teamId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» message|body|string|false|The message to send to all your team members.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ok": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="send-a-team-update-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The update has been posted successfully.|[Ok](#schemaok)|
|400|Bad Request|The update could not be posted.|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: team:lead )
</aside>

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-tournaments-arena">Tournaments (Arena)</h1>

Access Arena tournaments played on Lichess.
[Official Arena tournaments](https://lichess.org/tournament) are maintained by Lichess,
but you can [create your own Arena tournaments](https://lichess.org/tournament/new) as well.


## Get current tournaments

<a id="opIdapiTournament"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/tournament \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/tournament`

Get recently active and finished tournaments.
This API is used to display the [Lichess tournament schedule](https://lichess.org/tournament).

This operation does not require authentication

## Create a new Arena tournament

<a id="opIdapiTournamentPost"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/tournament \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'name=string&clockTime=2&clockIncrement=1&minutes=60&waitMinutes=5&startDate=0&variant=standard&rated=true&position=rnbqkbnr%2Fpppppppp%2F8%2F8%2F8%2F8%2FPPPPPPPP%2FRNBQKBNR%20w%20KQkq%20-%200%201&berserkable=true&streakable=true&hasChat=true&description=string&password=string&teamBattleByTeam=string&conditions.teamMember.teamId=string&conditions.minRating.rating=1000&conditions.maxRating.rating=2200&conditions.nbRatedGame.nb=0&conditions.allowList=string&conditions.bots=false&conditions.accountAge=1'
```

`POST /api/tournament`

Create a public or private Arena tournament.
This endpoint mirrors the form on <https://lichess.org/tournament/new>.
You can create up to 12 public tournaments per day, or 24 private tournaments.
A team battle can be created by specifying the `teamBattleByTeam` argument.
Additional restrictions:
  - clockTime + clockIncrement > 0
  - 15s and 0+1 variant tournaments cannot be rated
  - Clock time in comparison to tournament length must be reasonable: 3 <= (minutes * 60) / (96 * clockTime + 48 * clockIncrement + 15) <= 150


> Body parameter

```yaml
name: string
clockTime: 2
clockIncrement: 1
minutes: 60
waitMinutes: 5
startDate: 0
variant: standard
rated: true
position: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1
berserkable: true
streakable: true
hasChat: true
description: string
password: string
teamBattleByTeam: string
conditions.teamMember.teamId: string
conditions.minRating.rating: 1000
conditions.maxRating.rating: 2200
conditions.nbRatedGame.nb: 0
conditions.allowList: string
conditions.bots: false
conditions.accountAge: 1
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-arena-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|Parameters of the tournament|
|» name|body|string|false|The tournament name. Leave empty to get a random Grandmaster name|
|» clockTime|body|number|true|Clock initial time in minutes|
|» clockIncrement|body|integer|true|Clock increment in seconds|
|» minutes|body|integer|true|How long the tournament lasts, in minutes|
|» waitMinutes|body|integer|false|How long to wait before starting the tournament, from now, in minutes|
|» startDate|body|integer(int64)|false|Timestamp (in milliseconds) to start the tournament at a given date and time. Overrides the `waitMinutes` setting|
|» variant|body|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|none|
|» rated|body|boolean|false|Games are rated and impact players ratings|
|» position|body|[FromPositionFEN](#schemafrompositionfen)|false|Custom initial position (in X-FEN). Variant must be standard, fromPosition, or chess960 (if a valid 960 starting position), and the game cannot be rated.|
|» berserkable|body|boolean|false|Whether the players can use berserk. Only allowed if clockIncrement <= clockTime * 2|
|» streakable|body|boolean|false|After 2 wins, consecutive wins grant 4 points instead of 2.|
|» hasChat|body|boolean|false|Whether the players can discuss in a chat|
|» description|body|string|false|Anything you want to tell players about the tournament|
|» password|body|string|false|Make the tournament private, and restrict access with a password.<br>You can also [generate user-specific entry codes](https://github.com/lichess-org/api-demo/tree/master/example/tournament-entry-code)<br>based on this password.<br>|
|» teamBattleByTeam|body|string|false|Set the ID of a team you lead to create a team battle.<br>The other teams can be added using the [team battle edit endpoint](#tag/arena-tournaments/POST/api/tournament/team-battle/{id}).<br>|
|» conditions.teamMember.teamId|body|string|false|Restrict entry to members of a team.<br>The teamId is the last part of a team URL, e.g. `https://lichess.org/team/coders` has teamId = `coders`.<br>Leave empty to let everyone join the tournament.<br>Do not use this to create team battles, use `teamBattleByTeam` instead.<br>|
|» conditions.minRating.rating|body|integer|false|Minimum rating to join. Leave empty to let everyone join the tournament.|
|» conditions.maxRating.rating|body|integer|false|Maximum rating to join. Based on best rating reached in the last 7 days. Leave empty to let everyone join the tournament.|
|» conditions.nbRatedGame.nb|body|integer|false|Minimum number of rated games required to join.|
|» conditions.allowList|body|string|false|Predefined list of usernames that are allowed to join, separated by commas.<br>If this list is non-empty, then usernames absent from this list will be forbidden to join.<br>Adding `%titled` to the list additionally allows any titled player to join.<br>Example: `thibault,german11,%titled`<br>|
|» conditions.bots|body|boolean|false|Whether bots are allowed to join the tournament.|
|» conditions.accountAge|body|integer|false|Minium account age in days required to join.|

## Update an Arena tournament

<a id="opIdapiTournamentUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/tournament/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'name=string&clockTime=2&clockIncrement=1&minutes=60&waitMinutes=5&startDate=0&variant=standard&rated=true&position=rnbqkbnr%2Fpppppppp%2F8%2F8%2F8%2F8%2FPPPPPPPP%2FRNBQKBNR%20w%20KQkq%20-%200%201&berserkable=true&streakable=true&hasChat=true&description=string&password=string&conditions.minRating.rating=1000&conditions.maxRating.rating=2200&conditions.nbRatedGame.nb=0&conditions.allowList=string&conditions.bots=false&conditions.accountAge=1'
```

`POST /api/tournament/{id}`

Update an Arena tournament.
Be mindful not to make important changes to ongoing tournaments.
Can be used to update a team battle.
Additional restrictions:
  - clockTime + clockIncrement > 0
  - 15s and 0+1 variant tournaments cannot be rated
  - Clock time in comparison to tournament length must be reasonable: 3 <= (minutes * 60) / (96 * clockTime + 48 * clockIncrement + 15) <= 150


> Body parameter

```yaml
name: string
clockTime: 2
clockIncrement: 1
minutes: 60
waitMinutes: 5
startDate: 0
variant: standard
rated: true
position: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1
berserkable: true
streakable: true
hasChat: true
description: string
password: string
conditions.minRating.rating: 1000
conditions.maxRating.rating: 2200
conditions.nbRatedGame.nb: 0
conditions.allowList: string
conditions.bots: false
conditions.accountAge: 1
```

<h3 id="update-an-arena-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The tournament ID.|
|body|body|object|true|Parameters of the tournament|
|» name|body|string|false|The tournament name. Leave empty to get a random Grandmaster name|
|» clockTime|body|number|true|Clock initial time in minutes|
|» clockIncrement|body|integer|true|Clock increment in seconds|
|» minutes|body|integer|true|How long the tournament lasts, in minutes|
|» waitMinutes|body|integer|false|How long to wait before starting the tournament, from now, in minutes|
|» startDate|body|integer(int64)|false|Timestamp (in milliseconds) to start the tournament at a given date and time. Overrides the `waitMinutes` setting|
|» variant|body|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|none|
|» rated|body|boolean|false|Games are rated and impact players ratings|
|» position|body|[FromPositionFEN](#schemafrompositionfen)|false|Custom initial position (in X-FEN). Variant must be standard, fromPosition, or chess960 (if a valid 960 starting position), and the game cannot be rated.|
|» berserkable|body|boolean|false|Whether the players can use berserk. Only allowed if clockIncrement <= clockTime * 2|
|» streakable|body|boolean|false|After 2 wins, consecutive wins grant 4 points instead of 2.|
|» hasChat|body|boolean|false|Whether the players can discuss in a chat|
|» description|body|string|false|Anything you want to tell players about the tournament|
|» password|body|string|false|Make the tournament private, and restrict access with a password|
|» conditions.minRating.rating|body|integer|false|Minimum rating to join. Leave empty to let everyone join the tournament.|
|» conditions.maxRating.rating|body|integer|false|Maximum rating to join. Based on best rating reached in the last 7 days. Leave empty to let everyone join the tournament.|
|» conditions.nbRatedGame.nb|body|integer|false|Minimum number of rated games required to join.|
|» conditions.allowList|body|string|false|Predefined list of usernames that are allowed to join, separated by commas.<br>If this list is non-empty, then usernames absent from this list will be forbidden to join.<br>Adding `%titled` to the list additionally allows any titled player to join.<br>Example: `thibault,german11,%titled`<br>|
|» conditions.bots|body|boolean|false|Whether bots are allowed to join the tournament.|
|» conditions.accountAge|body|integer|false|Minium account age in days required to join.|
