## Join an Arena tournament

<a id="opIdapiTournamentJoin"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/tournament/hL7vMrFQ/join \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'password=string&team=string&pairMeAsap=false'
```

`POST /api/tournament/{id}/join`

Join an Arena tournament, possibly with a password and/or a team.
Also unpauses if you had previously [paused](#tag/arena-tournaments/POST/api/tournament/{id}/withdraw) the tournament.


> Body parameter

```yaml
password: string
team: string
pairMeAsap: false
```

<h3 id="join-an-arena-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The tournament ID.|
|body|body|object|false|You may need these depending on the tournament to join|
|» password|body|string|false|The tournament password, if one is required.<br>Can also be a [user-specific entry code](https://github.com/lichess-org/api-demo/tree/master/example/tournament-entry-code)<br>generated and shared by the organizer.<br>|
|» team|body|string|false|The team to join the tournament with, for team battle tournaments|
|» pairMeAsap|body|boolean|false|If the tournament is started, attempt to pair the user,<br>even if they are not connected to the tournament page.<br>This expires after one minute, to avoid pairing a user who is long gone.<br>You may call "join" again to extend the waiting.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ok": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="join-an-arena-tournament-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The tournament was successfully joined.|[Ok](#schemaok)|
|400|Bad Request|Joining the tournament failed.|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

## Pause or leave an Arena tournament

<a id="opIdapiTournamentWithdraw"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/tournament/hL7vMrFQ/withdraw \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/tournament/{id}/withdraw`

Leave a future Arena tournament, or take a break on an ongoing Arena tournament.
It's possible to join again later. Points and streaks are preserved.


<h3 id="pause-or-leave-an-arena-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The tournament ID.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ok": true
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="pause-or-leave-an-arena-tournament-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The tournament was successfully paused or left.|[Ok](#schemaok)|
|400|Bad Request|Pausing/leaving the tournament failed.|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: tournament:write )
</aside>

## Update a team battle

<a id="opIdapiTournamentTeamBattlePost"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/tournament/team-battle/stringst \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'teams=string&nbLeaders=0'
```

`POST /api/tournament/team-battle/{id}`

Set the teams and number of leaders of a team battle.
To update the other attributes of a team battle, use the [tournament update endpoint](#tag/arena-tournaments/POST/api/tournament/{id}).


> Body parameter

```yaml
teams: string
nbLeaders: 0
```

<h3 id="update-a-team-battle-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The tournament ID|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» teams|body|string|true|All team IDs of the team battle, separated by commas.<br>Make sure to always send the full list.<br>Teams that are not in the list will be removed from the team battle.<br>Example: `coders,zhigalko_sergei-fan-club,hhSwTKZv`<br>|
|» nbLeaders|body|integer|true|Number team leaders per team.|

## Export games of an Arena tournament

<a id="opIdgamesByTournament"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/tournament/string/games
```

`GET /api/tournament/{id}/games`

Download games of a tournament in PGN or [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) format.
Games are sorted by reverse chronological order (most recent first).
The game stream is throttled, depending on who is making the request:
  - Anonymous request: 20 games per second
  - [OAuth2 authenticated](#description/authentication) request: 30 games per second


<h3 id="export-games-of-an-arena-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Accept|header|string|false|Specify the desired response format.<br>Use `application/x-chess-pgn` to get the games in PGN format.<br>Use `application/x-ndjson` to get the games in ndjson format. [Read about ndjson here](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) and how you can parse it in Javascript.<br>|
|id|path|string|true|The tournament ID.|
|player|query|string|false|Only games of a particular player. Leave empty to fetch games of all players.|
|moves|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN moves.|
|pgnInJson|query|boolean|false|Include the full PGN within the JSON response, in a `pgn` field.|
|tags|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN tags.|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock status when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>Or in a `clocks` JSON field, as centisecond integers, depending on the response type.<br>|
|evals|query|boolean|false|Include analysis evaluations and comments, when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] } a3 { [%eval -1.09] }`<br>Or in an `analysis` JSON field, depending on the response type.<br>|
|accuracy|query|boolean|false|Include [accuracy percent](https://lichess.org/page/accuracy) of each player, when available. Only available in JSON.<br>|
|opening|query|boolean|false|Include the opening name.<br>Example: `[Opening "King's Gambit Accepted, King's Knight Gambit"]`<br>|
|division|query|boolean|false|Plies which mark the beginning of the middlegame and endgame.<br>Only available in JSON<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Accept|application/x-chess-pgn|
|Accept|application/x-ndjson|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```text
[Event "Blitz Titled Arena May '25"]
[Site "https://lichess.org/game/9qJGj3E6"]
[Date "2025.05.10"]
[Round "-"]
[White "GeNer4tion_KiLL"]
[Black "Moro182"]
[Result "0-1"]
[GameId "9qJGj3E6"]
[UTCDate "2025.05.10"]
[UTCTime "21:57:54"]
[WhiteElo "2703"]
[BlackElo "2672"]
[WhiteRatingDiff "-6"]
[BlackRatingDiff "+6"]
[WhiteTitle "FM"]
[BlackTitle "GM"]
[WhiteFideId "24248185"]
[WhiteBerserk "true"]
[BlackBerserk "true"]
[Variant "Standard"]
[TimeControl "180+0"]
[Termination "Normal"]

1. e4 d5 2. exd5 Bg4 3. Nc3 Bxd1 0-1

```

<h3 id="export-games-of-an-arena-tournament-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of games of an Arena tournament.|[GamePgn](#schemagamepgn)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get results of an Arena tournament

<a id="opIdresultsByTournament"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/tournament/string/results
```

`GET /api/tournament/{id}/results`

Players of an Arena tournament, with their score and performance, sorted by rank (best first).
**Players are streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json)**, i.e. one JSON object per line.
If called on an ongoing tournament, results can be inconsistent
due to ranking changes while the players are being streamed.
Use on finished tournaments for guaranteed consistency.


<h3 id="get-results-of-an-arena-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The tournament ID.|
|nb|query|integer|false|Max number of players to fetch|
|sheet|query|boolean|false|Add a `sheet` field to the player document.<br>It's an expensive server computation that slows down the stream.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "rank": 1,
  "score": 124,
  "rating": 2830,
  "username": "penguingim1",
  "title": "GM",
  "flair": "nature.penguin",
  "patronColor": 10,
  "performance": 2873,
  "sheet": {
    "scores": "2554230000452203303030523003024330543303000305533055330"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="get-results-of-an-arena-tournament-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The results of the Arena tournament.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-results-of-an-arena-tournament-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|rank|integer|true|none|none|
|score|integer|true|none|none|
|rating|integer|true|none|none|
|username|string|true|none|none|
|performance|integer|true|none|none|
|title|[Title](#schematitle)|false|none|only appears if the user is a titled player or a bot user|
|team|string|false|none|none|
|flair|[Flair](#schemaflair)|false|none|See [available flair list and images](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/flair)|
|patronColor|[PatronColor](#schemapatroncolor)|false|none|Players can choose a color for their Patron wings.<br>See [here for the color mappings](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/blob/master/ui/lib/css/abstract/_patron-colors.scss).<br><br>The presence of this field indicates the player is an active Patron.<br>|
|sheet|[ArenaSheet](#schemaarenasheet)|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|title|GM|
|title|WGM|
|title|IM|
|title|WIM|
|title|FM|
|title|WFM|
|title|NM|
|title|CM|
|title|WCM|
|title|WNM|
|title|LM|
|title|BOT|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of teams of a team battle tournament, with their respective top players.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-team-standing-of-a-team-battle-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|none|
|teams|[object]|true|none|none|
|» rank|integer|true|none|none|
|» id|string|true|none|none|

|» players|[object]|true|none|none|
|» » user|[LightUser](#schemalightuser)|true|none|none|
|» » score|integer|false|none|none|

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

## Get tournaments created by a user

<a id="opIdapiUserNameTournamentCreated"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/user/string/tournament/created \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/user/{username}/tournament/created`

Get all tournaments created by a given user.
Tournaments are sorted by reverse chronological order of start date (last starting first).
Tournaments are streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).
The stream is throttled, depending on who is making the request:
  - Anonymous request: 20 tournaments per second
  - [OAuth2 authenticated](#description/authentication) request: 30 tournaments per second
  - Authenticated, downloading your own tournaments: 50 tournaments per second


<h3 id="get-tournaments-created-by-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|The user whose created tournaments to fetch|
|nb|query|integer|false|Max number of tournaments to fetch|
|status|query|integer|false|Include tournaments in the given status: "Created" (10), "Started" (20), "Finished" (30)<br>You can add this parameter more than once to include tournaments in different statuses.<br>Example: `?status=10&status=20`<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|10|
|status|20|
|status|30|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "LojvlQOo",
  "createdBy": "natebrady23",
  "system": "arena",
  "minutes": 60,
  "clock": {
    "limit": 300,
    "increment": 3
  },
  "rated": false,
  "fullName": "Return of the BBB No. 140 Arena",
  "nbPlayers": 12,
  "variant": {
    "key": "standard",
    "short": "Std",
    "name": "Standard"
  },
  "startsAt": 1762914600000,
  "finishesAt": 1762918200000,
  "status": 30,
  "perf": {
    "key": "blitz",
    "name": "Blitz",
    "position": 1,
    "icon": ")"
  },
  "teamMember": "bradys-blunder-buddies",
  "winner": {
    "name": "Mennonite",
    "flair": "objects.closed-mailbox-with-raised-flag",
    "patron": true,
    "patronColor": 6,
    "id": "mennonite"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="get-tournaments-created-by-a-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of tournaments created by the user.|[ArenaTournament](#schemaarenatournament)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2
</aside>

## Get tournaments played by a user

<a id="opIdapiUserNameTournamentPlayed"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/user/string/tournament/played \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/user/{username}/tournament/played`

Get all tournaments played by a given user.
Tournaments are sorted by reverse chronological order of start date (last played first).
Tournaments are streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).
The stream is throttled, depending on who is making the request:
  - Anonymous request: 20 tournaments per second
  - [OAuth2 authenticated](#description/authentication) request: 30 tournaments per second
  - Authenticated, downloading your own tournaments: 50 tournaments per second


<h3 id="get-tournaments-played-by-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|The user whose played tournaments to fetch|
|nb|query|integer|false|Max number of tournaments to fetch|
|performance|query|boolean|false|Include the player performance rating in the response, at some cost for the server.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "tournament": {
    "id": "HRNeqiBb",
    "createdBy": "taketaketakeapp",
    "system": "arena",
    "minutes": 120,
    "clock": {
      "limit": 180,
      "increment": 0
```

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-tournaments-swiss">Tournaments (Swiss)</h1>

Access Swiss tournaments played on Lichess.
[Read more about Swiss tournaments.](https://lichess.org/swiss).


## Create a new Swiss tournament

<a id="opIdapiSwissNew"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/swiss/new/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'name=string&clock.limit=300&clock.increment=1&nbRounds=3&startsAt=0&roundInterval=-1&variant=standard&position=rnbqkbnr%2Fpppppppp%2F8%2F8%2F8%2F8%2FPPPPPPPP%2FRNBQKBNR%20w%20KQkq%20-%200%201&description=string&rated=true&password=string&forbiddenPairings=string&manualPairings=string&chatFor=20&conditions.minRating.rating=1000&conditions.maxRating.rating=2200&conditions.nbRatedGame.nb=0&conditions.playYourGames=false&conditions.allowList=string'
```

`POST /api/swiss/new/{teamId}`

Create a Swiss tournament for your team.
This endpoint mirrors the Swiss tournament form from your team pagee.
You can create up to 12 tournaments per day.
Additional restrictions:
  - clock.limit + clock.increment > 0
  - 15s and 0+1 variant tournaments cannot be rated


> Body parameter

```yaml
name: string
clock.limit: 300
clock.increment: 1
nbRounds: 3
startsAt: 0
roundInterval: -1
variant: standard
position: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1
description: string
rated: true
password: string
forbiddenPairings: string
manualPairings: string
chatFor: 20
conditions.minRating.rating: 1000
conditions.maxRating.rating: 2200
conditions.nbRatedGame.nb: 0
conditions.playYourGames: false
conditions.allowList: string
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-swiss-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|teamId|path|string|true|ID of the team|
|body|body|object|true|Parameters of the tournament|
|» name|body|string|false|The tournament name. Leave empty to get a random Grandmaster name|
|» clock.limit|body|integer|true|Clock initial time in seconds|
|» clock.increment|body|integer|true|Clock increment in seconds|
|» nbRounds|body|integer|true|Maximum number of rounds to play|
|» startsAt|body|integer(int64)|false|Timestamp in milliseconds to start the tournament at a given date and time. By default, it starts 10 minutes after creation.|
|» roundInterval|body|integer|false|How long to wait between each round, in seconds.<br>Set to 99999999 to manually schedule each round from the tournament UI.<br>If empty or -1, a sensible value is picked automatically.<br>|
|» variant|body|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|none|
|» position|body|[SwissFromPositionFEN](#schemaswissfrompositionfen)|false|Custom initial position (in X-FEN). Variant must be standard and the game cannot be rated.|
|» description|body|string|false|Anything you want to tell players about the tournament|
|» rated|body|boolean|false|Games are rated and impact players ratings|
|» password|body|string|false|Make the tournament private and restrict access with a password.|
|» forbiddenPairings|body|string|false|Usernames of players that must not play together.<br>Two usernames per line, separated by a space.<br>|
|» manualPairings|body|string|false|Manual pairings for the next round.<br>Two usernames per line, separated by a space. Example:<br>```<br>PlayerA PlayerB<br>PlayerC PlayerD<br>```<br>To give a bye (1 point) to a player instead of a pairing, add a line like so:<br>```<br>PlayerE 1<br>```<br>Missing players will be considered absent and get zero points.<br>|
|» chatFor|body|integer|false|Who can read and write in the chat.<br>- 0  = No-one<br>- 10 = Only team leaders<br>- 20 = Only team members<br>- 30 = All Lichess players<br>|
|» conditions.minRating.rating|body|integer|false|Minimum rating to join. Leave empty to let everyone join the tournament.|
|» conditions.maxRating.rating|body|integer|false|Maximum rating to join. Based on best rating reached in the last 7 days. Leave empty to let everyone join the tournament.|
|» conditions.nbRatedGame.nb|body|integer|false|Minimum number of rated games required to join.|
|» conditions.playYourGames|body|boolean|false|Only let players join if they have played their last swiss game.<br>If they failed to show up in a recent swiss event, they won't be able to enter yours.<br>This results in a better swiss experience for the players who actually show up.<br>|
|» conditions.allowList|body|string|false|Predefined list of usernames that are allowed to join, separated by commas.<br>If this list is non-empty, then usernames absent from this list will be forbidden to join.<br>Adding `%titled` to the list additionally allows any titled player to join.<br>Example: `thibault,german11,%titled`<br>|

## Update a Swiss tournament

<a id="opIdapiSwissUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/swiss/hL7vMrFQ/edit \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'name=string&clock.limit=300&clock.increment=1&nbRounds=3&startsAt=0&roundInterval=-1&variant=standard&position=rnbqkbnr%2Fpppppppp%2F8%2F8%2F8%2F8%2FPPPPPPPP%2FRNBQKBNR%20w%20KQkq%20-%200%201&description=string&rated=true&password=string&forbiddenPairings=string&manualPairings=string&chatFor=20&conditions.minRating.rating=1000&conditions.maxRating.rating=2200&conditions.nbRatedGame.nb=0&conditions.playYourGames=false&conditions.allowList=string'
```

`POST /api/swiss/{id}/edit`

Update a Swiss tournament.
Be mindful not to make important changes to ongoing tournaments.
Additional restrictions:
  - clock.limit + clock.increment > 0
  - 15s and 0+1 variant tournaments cannot be rated


> Body parameter

```yaml
name: string
clock.limit: 300
clock.increment: 1
nbRounds: 3
startsAt: 0
roundInterval: -1
variant: standard
position: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1
description: string
rated: true
password: string
forbiddenPairings: string
manualPairings: string
chatFor: 20
conditions.minRating.rating: 1000
conditions.maxRating.rating: 2200
conditions.nbRatedGame.nb: 0
conditions.playYourGames: false
conditions.allowList: string
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|body|body|object|true|Parameters of the tournament|
|» name|body|string|false|The tournament name. Leave empty to get a random Grandmaster name|
|» clock.limit|body|integer|true|Clock initial time in seconds|
|» clock.increment|body|integer|true|Clock increment in seconds|
|» nbRounds|body|integer|true|Maximum number of rounds to play|
|» startsAt|body|integer(int64)|false|Timestamp in milliseconds to start the tournament at a given date and time. By default, it starts 10 minutes after creation.|
|» roundInterval|body|integer|false|How long to wait between each round, in seconds.<br>Set to 99999999 to manually schedule each round from the tournament UI, or [with the API](#tag/tournaments-swiss/POST/api/swiss/{id}/schedule-next-round).<br>If empty or -1, a sensible value is picked automatically.<br>|
|» variant|body|[VariantKey](#schemavariantkey)|false|none|
|» position|body|[SwissFromPositionFEN](#schemaswissfrompositionfen)|false|Custom initial position (in X-FEN). Variant must be standard and the game cannot be rated.|
|» description|body|string|false|Anything you want to tell players about the tournament|
|» rated|body|boolean|false|Games are rated and impact players ratings|
|» password|body|string|false|Make the tournament private and restrict access with a password.|
|» forbiddenPairings|body|string|false|Usernames of players that must not play together.<br>Two usernames per line, separated by a space.<br>|
|» manualPairings|body|string|false|Manual pairings for the next round.<br>Two usernames per line, separated by a space.<br>Present players without a valid pairing will be given a bye, which is worth 1 point.<br>Forfeited players will get 0 points.<br>|
|» chatFor|body|integer|false|Who can read and write in the chat.<br>- 0  = No-one<br>- 10 = Only team leaders<br>- 20 = Only team members<br>- 30 = All Lichess players<br>|
|» conditions.minRating.rating|body|integer|false|Minimum rating to join. Leave empty to let everyone join the tournament.|
|» conditions.maxRating.rating|body|integer|false|Maximum rating to join. Based on best rating reached in the last 7 days. Leave empty to let everyone join the tournament.|
|» conditions.nbRatedGame.nb|body|integer|false|Minimum number of rated games required to join.|
|» conditions.playYourGames|body|boolean|false|Only let players join if they have played their last swiss game.<br>If they failed to show up in a recent swiss event, they won't be able to enter yours.<br>This results in a better swiss experience for the players who actually show up.<br>|

## Manually schedule the next round

<a id="opIdapiSwissScheduleNextRound"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/swiss/hL7vMrFQ/schedule-next-round \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'date=0'
```

`POST /api/swiss/{id}/schedule-next-round`

Manually schedule the next round date and time of a Swiss tournament.
This sets the `roundInterval` field to `99999999`, i.e. manual scheduling.
All further rounds will need to be manually scheduled, unless the `roundInterval` field is changed back to automatic scheduling.


> Body parameter

```yaml
date: 0
```

<h3 id="manually-schedule-the-next-round-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The tournament ID.|
|body|body|object|true|Parameters of the tournament|
|» date|body|integer(int64)|false|Timestamp in milliseconds to start the next round at a given date and time.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="manually-schedule-the-next-round-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|The Swiss tournament was successfully updated.|None|

|401|Unauthorized|This user cannot update this Swiss.|[SwissUnauthorisedEdit](#schemaswissunauthorisededit)|

|204|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

## Export games of a Swiss tournament

<a id="opIdgamesBySwiss"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/swiss/string/games
```

`GET /api/swiss/{id}/games`

Download games of a swiss tournament in PGN or [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) format.
Games are sorted by chronological order.
The game stream is throttled, depending on who is making the request:
  - Anonymous request: 20 games per second
  - [OAuth2 authenticated](#description/authentication) request: 30 games per second


<h3 id="export-games-of-a-swiss-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Accept|header|string|false|Specify the desired response format.<br>Use `application/x-chess-pgn` to get the games in PGN format.<br>Use `application/x-ndjson` to get the games in ndjson format. [Read about ndjson here](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) and how you can parse it in Javascript.<br>|
|id|path|string|true|The tournament ID.|
|player|query|string|false|Only the games played by a given player|
|moves|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN moves.|
|pgnInJson|query|boolean|false|Include the full PGN within the JSON response, in a `pgn` field.|
|tags|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN tags.|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock status when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>Or in a `clocks` JSON field, as centisecond integers, depending on the response type.<br>|
|evals|query|boolean|false|Include analysis evaluations and comments, when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `12. Bxf6 { [%eval 0.23] } a3 { [%eval -1.09] }`<br>Or in an `analysis` JSON field, depending on the response type.<br>|
|accuracy|query|boolean|false|Include [accuracy percent](https://lichess.org/page/accuracy) of each player, when available. Only available in JSON.<br>|
|opening|query|boolean|false|Include the opening name.<br>Example: `[Opening "King's Gambit Accepted, King's Knight Gambit"]`<br>|
|division|query|boolean|false|Plies which mark the beginning of the middlegame and endgame.<br>Only available in JSON<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Accept|application/x-chess-pgn|
|Accept|application/x-ndjson|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```text
[Event "Classical Increment"]
[Site "https://lichess.org/game/OsGgJSyo"]
[Date "2026.09.19"]
[Round "-"]
[White "aslanliosman10"]
[Black "AahirRotha_2017"]
[Result "1-0"]
[GameId "OsGgJSyo"]
[UTCDate "2026.09.19"]
[UTCTime "08:30:00"]
[WhiteElo "1884"]
[BlackElo "1073"]
[WhiteRatingDiff "+0"]
[BlackRatingDiff "-1"]
[Variant "Standard"]
[TimeControl "1500+3"]
[Termination "Normal"]

1. d4 e5 2. dxe5 Nc6 3. Nf3 d5 4. exd6 cxd6 1-0

```

<h3 id="export-games-of-a-swiss-tournament-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of games of a Swiss tournament.|[GamePgn](#schemagamepgn)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get results of a swiss tournament

<a id="opIdresultsBySwiss"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/swiss/string/results
```

`GET /api/swiss/{id}/results`

Players of a swiss tournament, with their score and performance, sorted by rank (best first).
Players are streamed as [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json).
If called on an ongoing tournament, results can be inconsistent
due to ranking changes while the players are being streamed.
Use on finished tournaments for guaranteed consistency.


<h3 id="get-results-of-a-swiss-tournament-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The tournament ID.|
|nb|query|integer|false|Max number of players to fetch|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "rank": 1,
  "points": 4.5,
  "tieBreak": 6.5,
  "rating": 1918,
  "username": "ali20551",
  "performance": 2272
}
```

<h3 id="get-results-of-a-swiss-tournament-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The results of a Swiss tournament.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-results-of-a-swiss-tournament-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|absent|boolean|false|none|none|
|rank|integer|true|none|none|
|points|number|true|none|none|
|tieBreak|number|true|none|none|
|rating|integer|true|none|none|
|username|string|true|none|none|
|title|[Title](#schematitle)|false|none|only appears if the user is a titled player or a bot user|
|performance|integer|true|none|none|

|title|BOT|

## Get best ongoing games of a TV channel

<a id="opIdtvChannelGames"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/tv/string
```

`GET /api/tv/{channel}`

Get a list of ongoing games for a given TV channel. Similar to [lichess.org/games](https://lichess.org/games).
Available in PGN or [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) format, depending on the request `Accept` header.


<h3 id="get-best-ongoing-games-of-a-tv-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Accept|header|string|false|Specify the desired response format.<br>Use `application/x-chess-pgn` to get the games in PGN format.<br>Use `application/x-ndjson` to get the games in ndjson format. [Read about ndjson here](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) and how you can parse it in Javascript.<br>|
|channel|path|string|true|The name of the channel in camel case.|
|nb|query|integer|false|Number of games to fetch.|
|moves|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN moves.|
|pgnInJson|query|boolean|false|Include the full PGN within the JSON response, in a `pgn` field.|
|tags|query|boolean|false|Include the PGN tags.|
|clocks|query|boolean|false|Include clock status when available.<br>Either as PGN comments: `2. exd5 { [%clk 1:01:27] } e5 { [%clk 1:01:28] }`<br>Or in a `clocks` JSON field, as centisecond integers, depending on the response type.<br>|
|opening|query|boolean|false|Include the opening name.<br>Example: `[Opening "King's Gambit Accepted, King's Knight Gambit"]`<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Accept|application/x-chess-pgn|
|Accept|application/x-ndjson|

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-users">Users</h1>

Access registered users on Lichess.
<https://lichess.org/player>

- Each user blog exposes an atom (RSS) feed, like <https://lichess.org/@/thibault/blog.atom>
- User blogs mashup feed: https://lichess.org/blog/community.atom
- User blogs mashup feed for a language: https://lichess.org/blog/community/fr.atom


## Get real-time users status

<a id="opIdapiUsersStatus"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://lichess.org/api/users/status?ids=thibault%2Cmaia1%2Cmaia5' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/users/status`

Read the `online`, `playing` and `streaming` flags of several users.
This API is very fast and cheap on lichess side.
So you can call it quite often (like once every 5 seconds).
Use it to track players and know when they're connected on lichess and playing games.


<h3 id="get-real-time-users-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ids|query|string|true|User IDs separated by commas. Up to 100 IDs.|
|withSignal|query|boolean|false|Also return the network signal of the player, when available.<br>It ranges from 1 (poor connection, lag > 500ms) to 4 (great connection, lag < 150ms)<br>Defaults to `false` to preserve server resources.<br>|
|withGameIds|query|boolean|false|Also return the ID of the game being played, if any, for each player, in a `playingId` field.<br>Defaults to `false` to preserve server resources.<br>|
|withGameMetas|query|boolean|false|Also return the id, time control and variant of the game being played, if any, for each player, in a `playing` field.<br>Defaults to `false` to preserve server resources. Disables `withGameIds`.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "name": "Mary",
    "flair": "people.man-in-steamy-room-medium-skin-tone",
    "patron": true,
    "patronColor": 1,
    "id": "mary"
  },
  {
    "name": "Ana",
    "title": "WNM",
    "flair": "people.woman-getting-massage-medium-skin-tone",
    "id": "ana"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="get-real-time-users-status-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of users and their respective statuses.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-real-time-users-status-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[object]|false|none|none|
|» id|string|true|none|none|
|» name|string|true|none|none|
|» flair|[Flair](#schemaflair)|false|none|See [available flair list and images](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/flair)|
|» title|[Title](#schematitle)|false|none|only appears if the user is a titled player or a bot user|
|» online|boolean|false|none|none|
|» playing|boolean|false|none|none|
|» streaming|boolean|false|none|none|
|» patron|[Patron](#schemapatron)|false|none|**Deprecated.** Use patronColor value instead to determine if player is a patron.<br>|
|» patronColor|[PatronColor](#schemapatroncolor)|false|none|Players can choose a color for their Patron wings.<br>See [here for the color mappings](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/blob/master/ui/lib/css/abstract/_patron-colors.scss).<br><br>The presence of this field indicates the player is an active Patron.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» title|GM|
|» title|WGM|
|» title|IM|
|» title|WIM|
|» title|FM|
|» title|WFM|
|» title|NM|
|» title|CM|
|» title|WCM|
|» title|WNM|
|» title|LM|
|» title|BOT|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get one leaderboard

<a id="opIdplayerTopNbPerfType"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/player/top/100/bullet \
  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.lichess.v3+json'
```

`GET /api/player/top/{nb}/{perfType}`

Get the leaderboard for a single speed or variant (a.k.a. `perfType`).
There is no leaderboard for correspondence or puzzles.
See <https://lichess.org/player/top/bullet>.


<h3 id="get-one-leaderboard-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|nb|path|integer|true|How many users to fetch|
|perfType|path|string|true|The speed or variant|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|perfType|ultraBullet|
|perfType|bullet|
|perfType|blitz|
|perfType|rapid|
|perfType|classical|
|perfType|chess960|
|perfType|crazyhouse|
|perfType|antichess|
|perfType|atomic|
|perfType|horde|
|perfType|kingOfTheHill|
|perfType|racingKings|
|perfType|threeCheck|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "users": [
    {
      "id": "lola",
      "username": "Lola",
      "perfs": {
        "blitz": {
          "rating": 2451,
          "progress": 0
        }
      },
      "title": "WFM",
      "patron": true,
      "patronColor": 1
    },
    {
      "id": "yulia",
      "username": "Yulia",
      "perfs": {
        "blitz": {
          "rating": 2372,
          "progress": 0
        }
      },
      "title": "NM"
    },
    {
      "id": "angel",
      "username": "Angel",
      "perfs": {
        "blitz": {
          "rating": 2306,
          "progress": 0
        }
      },
      "title": "WFM"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-one-leaderboard-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of top players for the variant.|[Leaderboard](#schemaleaderboard)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get user public data

<a id="opIdapiUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/user/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/user/{username}`

Read public data of a user.


<h3 id="get-user-public-data-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|none|
|trophies|query|boolean|false|Include user trophies|
|profile|query|boolean|false|Include user profile data|
|rank|query|boolean|false|Include global lichess ranking for each perf|
|fideId|query|boolean|false|Include public FIDE ID if any|

## Get rating history of a user

<a id="opIdapiUserRatingHistory"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/user/string/rating-history \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/user/{username}/rating-history`

Read rating history of a user, for all perf types.
There is at most one entry per day.
Format of an entry is `[year, month, day, rating]`.
`month` starts at zero (January).

Note: Rating history is generated on demand by [Authenticated OAuth requests](#description/authentication).
Unauthenticated requests will return a cached version of the rating history if present, otherwise an empty array.


<h3 id="get-rating-history-of-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|none|

## Get performance statistics of a user

<a id="opIdapiUserPerf"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/user/string/perf/ultraBullet \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/user/{username}/perf/{perf}`

Read performance statistics of a user, for a single performance.
Similar to the [performance pages on the website](https://lichess.org/@/thibault/perf/bullet).


<h3 id="get-performance-statistics-of-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|path|string|true|none|
|perf|path|[PerfType](#schemaperftype)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|perf|ultraBullet|
|perf|bullet|
|perf|blitz|
|perf|rapid|
|perf|classical|
|perf|correspondence|
|perf|chess960|
|perf|crazyhouse|
|perf|antichess|
|perf|atomic|
|perf|horde|
|perf|kingOfTheHill|
|perf|racingKings|
|perf|threeCheck|

## Get users by ID

<a id="opIdapiUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/users \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d 'thibault,maia1,maia5'
```

`POST /api/users`

Get up to 300 users by their IDs. Users are returned in the same order as the IDs.
The method is `POST` to allow a longer list of IDs to be sent in the request body.
Please do not try to download all the Lichess users with this endpoint, or any other endpoint.
An API is not a way to fully export a website. We do not provide a full download of the Lichess users.
This endpoint is limited to 8,000 users every 10 minutes, and 120,000 every day.


> Body parameter

```text
thibault,maia1,maia5
```

<h3 id="get-users-by-id-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|profile|query|boolean|false|Include user profile data|
|rank|query|boolean|false|Include global lichess ranking for each perf|

## Get crosstable

<a id="opIdapiCrosstable"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/crosstable/string/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/crosstable/{user1}/{user2}`

Get total number of games, and current score, of any two users.
If the `matchup` flag is provided, and the users are currently playing, also gets the current match game number and scores.


<h3 id="get-crosstable-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user1|path|string|true|none|
|user2|path|string|true|none|
|matchup|query|boolean|false|Whether to get the current match data, if any|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "users": {
    "drnykterstein": 753.5,
    "rebeccaharris": 459.5
  },
  "nbGames": 1213
}
```

<h3 id="get-crosstable-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The crosstable of the two users.|[Crosstable](#schemacrosstable)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Autocomplete usernames

<a id="opIdapiPlayerAutocomplete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://lichess.org/api/player/autocomplete?term=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/player/autocomplete`

Provides autocompletion options for an incomplete username.


<h3 id="autocomplete-usernames-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|term|query|string|true|The beginning of a username|
|exists|query|boolean|false|If `true`, only checks if the user exists.<br>|
|object|query|boolean|false|- `false` returns an array of usernames<br>- `true` returns an object with matching users<br>|
|names|query|boolean|false|- `false` returns an array of usernames<br>- `true` returns an array of usernames with preferred casing<br>|
|friend|query|boolean|false|Returns followed players matching `term` if any, else returns other players.<br>Requires [OAuth](#tag/OAuth).<br>|
|team|query|string|false|Search within a team.<br>Use team ID/slug.<br>|
|tour|query|string|false|Search within a arena tournament.<br>Use tournament ID.<br>|
|swiss|query|string|false|Search within a Swiss tournament.<br>|
|teacher|query|boolean|false|Only search for players who also have a teacher role.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  "bobby"
]
```

<h3 id="autocomplete-usernames-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|An array of players which usernames start with the provided term.|Inline|

<h3 id="autocomplete-usernames-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[string]|false|none|none|
|*anonymous*|[string]|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|result|[[LightUserOnline](#schemalightuseronline)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
Authentication is optional for this operation. To authenticate, use one of the following methods:
OAuth2
</aside>

<h1 id="lichessorg-api-reference-oauth">OAuth</h1>

Obtaining and revoking OAuth tokens.

[Read about the Lichess API authentication methods and code examples](https://github.com/lichess-org/api-demo/blob/master/example/README.md).


## Request authorization code

<a id="opIdoauth"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://lichess.org/oauth?response_type=code&client_id=example.com&redirect_uri=string&code_challenge_method=S256&code_challenge=string'
```

`GET /oauth`

OAuth2 authorization endpoint.
Start the OAuth2 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE by securely
generating two random strings unique to each authorization
request:

* `code_verifier`
* `state`

Store these in session storage. Make sure not to reveal `code_verifier`
to eavesdroppers. Do not show it in URLs, do not abuse `state` to store
it, do not send it over insecure connections. However it is fine if
the user themselves can extract `code_verifier`, which will always be
possible for fully client-side apps.
Then send the user to this endpoint. They will be prompted to grant
authorization and then be redirected back to the given `redirect_uri`.
If the authorization failed, the following query string parameters will
be appended to the redirection:

* `error`, in particular with value `access_denied` if the user
   cancelled authorization
* `error_description` to aid debugging
* `state`, exactly as passed in the `state` parameter

If the authorization succeeded, the following query string parameters
will be appended to the redirection:

* `code`, containing a fresh short-lived authorization code
* `state`, exactly as passed in the `state` parameter

Next, to defend against cross site request forgery, check that the
returned `state` matches the `state` you originally generated.

Finally, continue by using the authorization code to
[obtain an access token](#tag/oauth/POST/api/token).


<h3 id="request-authorization-code-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|response_type|query|string|true|Must be `code`.|
|client_id|query|string|true|Arbitrary identifier that uniquely identifies your application.|
|redirect_uri|query|string|true|The absolute URL that the user should be redirected to with the authorization result.|
|code_challenge_method|query|string|true|Must be `S256`.|
|code_challenge|query|string|true|Compute `BASE64URL(SHA256(code_verifier))`.|
|scope|query|string|false|Space separated list of requested OAuth scopes, if any.|
|username|query|string|false|Hint that you want the user to log in with a specific Lichess username.|
|state|query|string|false|Arbitrary state that will be returned verbatim with the authorization result.|

<h3 id="request-authorization-code-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Authorization prompt will be displayed to the user.|None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Obtain access token

<a id="opIdapiToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/token \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d 'grant_type=authorization_code&code=liu_iS1uOZg99Htmo58ex2jKgYziUfzsnAl0&code_verifier=Ry1rbGdOMTQtUjhOc0lmTnFKak1LTHV0NjlRMll2aXYtTThkQnlJRkRpaGwyQjh0ZDNFdzFPSG9KUlY4M1NrRzJ5ZHhUdjVZR08zLTZOT3dCN2xLfjZOXzU2WHk4SENP&redirect_uri=http%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2F&client_id=example.com'
```

`POST /api/token`

OAuth2 token endpoint. Exchanges an authorization code for an access token.


> Body parameter

```yaml
grant_type: authorization_code
code: liu_iS1uOZg99Htmo58ex2jKgYziUfzsnAl0
code_verifier: Ry1rbGdOMTQtUjhOc0lmTnFKak1LTHV0NjlRMll2aXYtTThkQnlJRkRpaGwyQjh0ZDNFdzFPSG9KUlY4M1NrRzJ5ZHhUdjVZR08zLTZOT3dCN2xLfjZOXzU2WHk4SENP
redirect_uri: "http://example.com/"
client_id: example.com
```

<h3 id="obtain-access-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» grant_type|body|string|false|none|
|» code|body|string|false|The authorization code that was sent in the `code` parameter to your `redirect_uri`.|
|» code_verifier|body|string|false|A `code_challenge` was used to request the authorization code. This must be the `code_verifier` it was derived from.|
|» redirect_uri|body|string|false|Must match the `redirect_uri` used to request the authorization code.|
|» client_id|body|string|false|Must match the `client_id` used to request the authorization code.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "token_type": "string",
  "access_token": "string",
  "expires_in": 0
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error": "string",
  "error_description": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="obtain-access-token-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Access token successfully obtained.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Failed to obtain access token.|[OAuthError](#schemaoautherror)|

<h3 id="obtain-access-token-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|token_type|string|true|none|none|
|access_token|string|true|none|none|
|expires_in|integer|true|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|
|400|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Revoke access token

<a id="opIdapiTokenDelete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/token \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/token`

Revokes the access token sent as Bearer for this request.

<h3 id="revoke-access-token-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Access token revoked.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|204|Access-Control-Allow-Origin|string||none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2
</aside>

## Test multiple OAuth tokens

<a id="opIdtokenTest"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://lichess.org/api/token/test \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d 'lip_jose,lip_badToken
'
```

`POST /api/token/test`

For up to 1000 OAuth tokens,
returns their associated user ID and scopes,
or `null` if the token is invalid.
The method is `POST` so a longer list of tokens can be sent in the request body.


> Body parameter

```text
lip_jose,lip_badToken

```

<h3 id="test-multiple-oauth-tokens-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|string|true|OAuth tokens separated by commas. Up to 1000.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "lip_jose": {
    "userId": "jose",
    "scopes": "preference:read,preference:write,email:read,challenge:read,challenge:write,challenge:bulk,study:read,study:write,tournament:read,tournament:write,racer:write,puzzle:read,puzzle:write,team:read,team:write,team:lead,follow:read,follow:write,msg:write,note:write,board:play,bot:play,engine:read,engine:write,web:mod",
    "expires": null
  },
  "lip_badToken": null
}
```

<h3 id="test-multiple-oauth-tokens-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The representation of the OAuth tokens.|Inline|

<h3 id="test-multiple-oauth-tokens-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|**additionalProperties**|object \| null|false|none|none|
|» *oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|» userId|string|false|none|none|
|» scopes|string|false|none|Comma-separated list of scopes. Empty string if the token has no scopes.|
|» expires|integer \| null|false|none|Unix-timestamp in milliseconds or null if the token never expires.|
|» *oneOf*|null|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

|follow|boolean|false|none|none|
|highlight|boolean|false|none|none|
|destination|boolean|false|none|none|

|replay|integer|false|none|none|
|challenge|integer|false|none|none|
|message|integer|false|none|none|
|submitMove|integer|false|none|none|

|insightShare|integer|false|none|none|
|keyboardMove|integer|false|none|1 = input moves with the keyboard|
|voiceMove|boolean|false|none|none|
|zen|integer|false|none|0 = No, 1 = yes, 2 = in-game only|
|ratings|integer|false|none|0 = Hide ratings, 1 = Show ratings, 2 = Show ratings except in-game|
|moveEvent|integer|false|none|none|
|rookCastle|integer|false|none|0 = Move king two squares, 1 = Move king onto rook|
|flairs|boolean|false|none|Show player flairs|
|sayGG|integer|false|none|0 = No, 1 = When losing, 2 = When losing or drawing|

<h2 id="tocS_BroadcastForm">BroadcastForm</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabroadcastform"></a>
<a id="schema_BroadcastForm"></a>
<a id="tocSbroadcastform"></a>
<a id="tocsbroadcastform"></a>

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "info": {
    "format": "string",
    "tc": "string",
    "fideTC": "standard",
    "timeZone": "string",
    "location": "string",
    "players": "string",
    "website": "http://example.com",
    "standings": "http://example.com",
    "regulations": "http://example.com"
  },
  "markdown": "string",
  "showScores": false,
  "showRatingDiffs": false,
  "teamTable": false,
  "visibility": "public",
  "players": "string",
  "teams": "string",
  "tier": 3,
  "tiebreaks": [
    "AOB"
  ],
  "grouping": {
    "info": {
      "name": "Chess Olympiad | Open",
      "tours": "wYigbpXq\nM5YHvpOX\nq6ezoCXP\n"
    },
    "scoreGroups": [
      "wYigbpXq,M5YHvpOX"
    ]
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the broadcast tournament.<br><br>Example: `Sinquefield Cup`<br>|
|info|[BroadcastTourInfo](#schemabroadcasttourinfo)|false|none|Additional display information about the tournament|
|markdown|string|false|none|Optional long description of the broadcast. Markdown is supported.<br>|
|showScores|boolean|false|none|Show players scores based on game results<br>|
|showRatingDiffs|boolean|false|none|Show player's rating diffs<br>|
|teamTable|boolean|false|none|Show a team leaderboard. Requires WhiteTeam and BlackTeam PGN tags.<br>|
|visibility|string|false|none|Who can view the broadcast.<br>* `public`: Default. Anyone can view the broadcast<br>* `unlisted`: Only people with the link can view the broadcast<br>* `private`: Only the broadcast owner(s) can view the broadcast<br>|
|players|string|false|none|Optional replace player names, ratings and titles.<br><br>One line per player, formatted as such:<br><br>```txt<br>player name / FIDE ID<br>```<br><br>Example:<br><br>```txt<br>Magnus Carlsen / 1503014<br>```<br><br>Player names ignore case and punctuation, and match all possible combinations of 2 words: "Jorge Rick Vito" will match "Jorge Rick", "jorge vito", "Rick, Vito", etc.<br><br>If the player is NM or WNM, you can:<br><br>```txt<br>player name / FIDE ID / title<br>```<br><br>Alternatively, you may set tags manually, like so:<br><br>```txt<br>player name / rating / title / new name<br>```<br><br>All values are optional. Example:<br>```txt<br>Magnus Carlsen / 2863 / GM<br>YouGotLittUp / 1890 / / Louis Litt<br>```<br>|
|teams|string|false|none|Optional: assign players to teams<br><br>One line per player, formatted as such:<br>```txt<br>Team name; Fide Id or Player name<br>```<br><br>Example:<br>```txt<br>Team Cats ; 3408230<br>Team Dogs ; Scooby Doo<br>```<br><br>By default the PGN tags WhiteTeam and BlackTeam are used.<br>|
|tier|integer|false|none|Optional, for Lichess admins only, used to feature on /broadcast.<br><br>* `3` for Official: normal tier<br>* `4` for Official: high tier<br>* `5` for Official: best tier<br>|
|tiebreaks|[[BroadcastTiebreakExtendedCode](#schemabroadcasttiebreakextendedcode)]|false|none|none|
|grouping|object|false|none|Group this broadcast along with others<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_FIDEPlayerRatings">FIDEPlayerRatings</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemafideplayerratings"></a>
<a id="schema_FIDEPlayerRatings"></a>
<a id="tocSfideplayerratings"></a>
<a id="tocsfideplayerratings"></a>

```json
{
  "standard": [
    0
  ],
  "rapid": [
    0
  ],
  "blitz": [
    0
  ]
}
```

Data points are encoded. Each number contains a year, a month, and an elo rating.

`2015081568` -> `August 2015: 1568`

Here's an example decoding implementation in JS:

```js
  const decodePoint = point => {
    const elo = point % 10000;
    const dateNum = Math.floor(point / 10000);
    const year = Math.floor(dateNum / 100);
    const month = dateNum % 100;
    return [year, month, elo];
  };
```

Consecutive months with same elo are omitted. For a given elo, only the first and last month are provided.

### Properties

In this case, the request must not be made via<br>CORS, so that the token is not revealed to any of the users.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|category|string|true|none|`cursed-win` and `blessed-loss` means the 50-move rule prevents<br>the decisive result.<br><br>`syzygy-win` and `syzygy-loss` means exact result is unknown due to<br>[DTZ rounding](https://syzygy-tables.info/metrics#dtz), i.e., the<br>win or loss could also be prevented by the 50-move rule if<br>the user has deviated from the tablebase recommendation since the<br>last pawn move or capture.<br><br>`maybe-win` and `maybe-loss` means the result with regard to the<br>50-move rule is unknown, because DTZ is unknown and the DTC tablebase<br>does not guarantee to reach a zeroing move as soon as possible.<br>|
|dtz|null \| integer|false|none|[DTZ50'' with rounding](https://syzygy-tables.info/metrics#dtz) in plies<br>(for Standard chess positions with not more than 7 pieces and variant<br>positions not more than 6 pieces)<br>|
|precise_dtz|null \| integer|false|none|DTZ50'' in plies, only if guaranteed to not be rounded, or absent if unknown<br>|
|dtc|null \| integer|false|none|Depth to Conversion: Moves to next capture, promotion,<br>or checkmate. Available for:<br>* Standard chess positions with 8 pieces, more than one pawn of material<br>  value for each side, and at least one pair of opposing pawns,<br>  short *op1*, if query parameter `dtc` is `auxiliary` or `always`.<br>* Some standard chess positions with up to 7 pieces, if query parameter<br>  `dtc` is `always`. Work in progress.<br>|
|dtm|null \| integer|false|none|Depth To Mate: Plies to mate (available only for Standard positions<br>with not more than 6 pieces)<br>|
|dtw|null \| integer|false|none|Depth To Win: Plies to win (available only for Antichess positions<br>with not more than 4 pieces)<br>|
|checkmate|boolean|false|none|none|
|stalemate|boolean|false|none|none|
|variant_win|boolean|false|none|Only in chess variants|
|variant_loss|boolean|false|none|Only in chess variants|
|insufficient_material|boolean|false|none|none|
|moves|[[TablebaseMove](#schematablebasemove)]|true|none|Information about legal moves, best first|
